publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: An intelligent access vehicle system is designed. Through the cloud network communication between the MCU and the wechat app mobile client, the data information of the parking lot collected by the MCU is displayed for the user to query and reserve the parking space; At the same time, PLC is used to receive and process the access vehicle signal sent by MCU, and output a series of control signals. The step motor driver is used to control the step motor to realize the transmission device to automatically and accurately complete the vehicle access operation in the designated parking space. This design solves a series of problems existing in traditional parking lot when using manual registration and management of vehicle access, and improves the use efficiency of parking space.

articleTitle: Research on Big Data's Prevention Technology of Financial Systemic Risk
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to reduce the seriousness and frequency of financial systemic risk in the new era, this paper puts forward a novel big data prevention technology of financial systemic risk. With the combination of big data technology, Internet technology and cloud computing technology, this technology can monitor the financial market in real time and guard against suspicious information. The research results show that this technology realizes the close combination of big data and the financial market, reduces the cross-infection of financial systemic risk, and improves the controllability of financial systemic risk.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Skin Color Detection Method Based on FCM with Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of purchasing cosmetics, female always rely on their intuition or follow the fashion trend for color selection. They never understand how to select the right color to match with them. A systematic method for detecting the facial skin colors of female for the application for make-up is proposed in this study. In this method, the female face recognition with considerable images was first discussed. Next, the innovative method of capturing color with points was discussed along with making the complexion-aggregated analysis. In the study, RGB was conversed to be Lab space for collected data. The data were analyzed based on fuzzy clustering to get grouping. The results were presented in the final grouping Lab value and RGB index. Besides, a FaceRGB program was constructed to capture color automatically from 13000 images. 17 clustering results were obtained by the ColorFCM program constructed in this study. The results can be used to select the customized color of cosmetics to satisfy female and an expert system can further be made in the future.

Author Keywords: Facial skin color, cosmetic, FCM, big data

articleTitle: Optimization of Server Scheduling Based on Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low efficiency of services deployment of cloud computing platform by using exhaustive search algorithm, and in order to obtain a better services deployment scheme, a novel cloud computing services deployment optimization method, based on improved particle swarm optimization algorithm, is proposed. Firstly, it analyzes the deployment problem of the cloud computing service, converts the cloud computing service deployment problem into a multi-objective combination optimization problem and establishes a corresponding mathematical model. Then it uses the particle swarm algorithm with a strong global search ability to solve the mathematical model and improves the problem of slow convergence and premature convergence of the standard particle swarm algorithm. Finally, it verifies the feasibility of the simulation test. The experimental results show that the proposed method can find the optimal cloud computing service deployment scheme quickly and provide a valuable reference for cloud computing service providers.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis Method for Peak Shaving of Wind Storage Combined System Considering Energy Storage Participating In Peak Shaving
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The purpose of the operation of the combined wind and gas system is to reduce system frequency fluctuations and system peak-to-valley differences caused by wind power output. In this paper, the peaking economy of the combined system of wind storage is taken as the research object, and the peaking optimization scheduling model of the wind storage combined system with energy storage system is established. The standard deviation of the daily load curve is the smallest and the operating cost of the system is the lowest. The analysis method of the peaking economy of the storage joint system.

articleTitle: Spatial and Temporal Variations of Microcystis Aeruginosa and Their Influencing Factors in Bosten Lake
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The Microcystis aeruginosa was investigated in Bosten Lake from May 2012 to November 2012 and January 2013. Then the Spatial and temporal variations of Microcystis aeruginosa and their influencing factors were analyzed. The results showed that: (1)The density of Microcystis aeruginosa in Bosten Lake is relatively low because of the mineralization, and take a small proportion in phytoplankton. (2)The Microcystis aeruginosa increased gradually in September and October, and reached the maximum value 1183.88 ind./L in November, while the density of cells in other months was only about 1ind./L.(3) The density of Microcystisaeruginosais higher in the eastern area of Bosten Lake than that in the western area, and the concentration of nitrogen and the wind might be the influences.

articleTitle: Influence of Greenfield Landscape on Urban Skyline of North Canal of Tongzhou
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The canal is an important urban component of Tongzhou, a sub-center of Beijing. It plays an important role in expressing and recognizing the characteristics of the city, and it also has a subtle effect on the formation of a beautiful urban environment image in Tongzhou. The design of plant landscape belts on both sides of the canal, especially the design of riparian plants, plays a very important role in optimizing the skyline. This study mainly focuses on the problem of improving the skyline from the perspective of green landscape. Through multi-channel, multi-level, multi-angle definition of the status of the target area and urban landscape skyline profile characteristics analysis, to optimize the Tongzhou skyline to provide ideas.

articleTitle: Continuous Box-Girder Bridge Condition Assessment Based on Structural Health Monitoring System: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Fu-Sui Bridge is a continuous box-girder bridge located in mainland China, crossing the Songhua River and connecting two towns: Fu Jin and Sui Bin. The entire construction of Fu-Sui bridge lasted three years from 2008 to 2011. In the bridge location region, the temperature in winter is extremely cold, exceeding down to -30 oC. A long-term structure health monitoring system has been designed and installed to monitor the behaviour of the bridge with the enormous fluctuation of temperature between the summer and the winter. During one-year field monitoring, strain and displacement sensors of the bridge have been identified and addressed giving valuable information for the long-term evaluation of the behaviour of Fu-Sui Bridge. The following conclusions are obtained in this study: (1) the influence of low temperature on the observation is more dominant than the high temperature; and (2) the strain variation and deflection corresponds to a typical thermal coefficient of expansion of concrete with different slopes and the temperature effect may not produce in a short term while reflection of the cumulative effect on the cross sections of bridges.

articleTitle: Review of Research on Seismic Retrofit Technology of RC Bridge Pier
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the typical failure modes of RC piers in recent destructive earthquakes, the advantages and disadvantages of conventional RC piers for seismic retrofit technology are summarized, and the research progress of applying new materials to strengthen piers is introduced. Research shows that the use of steel wire rope, BFRP, and shape memory alloy retrofit can effectively improve the seismic performance of the pier, but single technology retrofit has its limitations, and multiple technology composite retrofit can overcome the shortcomings of the single technology. The seismic retrofit technology of bridge piers mentioned in the article can provide a reference for the retrofit and repair of RC structures that have been damaged after earthquakes, fires, explosions and corrosion and aging.

articleTitle: Subglacial Lakes, Drainage Pathways and Basins Beneath the Antarctic Ice Sheet Based on the Remote Sensing Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Antarctic subglacial lakes which form an important component of the subglacial hydrological system have the potential to study the history of the ice sheet and the global climate change. In order to detect the potential subglacial lakes beneath the Antarctic ice sheet. A dynamic threshold filtering algorithm has been applied on the CryoSat-2 satellite altimetry remote sensing data to derive the Antarctic potential subglacial lakes including the quantities, areas as well as drainage pathways. And we have compared the difference of the experimental results obtained by CryoSat-2 and Bedmap2 datasets. Our results show the superiority by using the CryoSat-2 data, which have filled the gap in the central area of the Antarctic. Besides CryoSat-2 Altimetry data can generate a rather accurate DEM of the Antarctic ice sheet by this algorithm. As a result, we have detected many more lakes covering about 3% of the total bed of Antarctic than were observed before. There are some direct hydrological connections between a large number of subglacial lakes beneath the Antarctic ice sheet.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Saving Algorithm in Wireless Sensor Network Based on Mobile Agent
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In the traditional wireless sensor network (WSN), it is assumed that the sensor node position is fixed and ignoring the impact of node position changes on network performance. Aiming at above problems, this paper discusses a hotspot in Internet technology research - mobile IP technology and proposes a method for importing mobile agent technology into wireless sensor networks to improve network performance. According to the basic routing mechanism and rules of the Mobile IP protocol, a functional entity mobile agent is implemented. The proposed method makes certain modifications in the Linux kernel which implements tunnel encapsulation of data packets at the network layer. And it sends proxy ARP messages on the data link layer to intercept packets destined for mobile nodes. Performance simulation experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can still maintain good performance when the position of the node changes.

articleTitle: Study of Cathodic Protection System for Oil Well Casings Based on Pulse Current
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Impressed Current Cathodic Protection(ICCP) is the most effective method for mitigating corrosion on oil well casings. ICCP systems are commonly based on direct current(DC) power supply, DC power supply determine the protective effect. However, traditional DC protection exist some problems, such as protect depth is not enough, uneven distribution of current and potential. In this study, a kind of cathodic protection system for oil well casing based on pulse current is designed. Pulse current is used as the polarization current required for cathodic polarization of oil wells. When electrons flow through the formation to the surface of the casing, electronic will not react with the surrounding corrosive substances at the same time. Electrons will gather at the surface of the casing, Potential direction of the casing surface is shifted to the negative direction, and Produce cathodic polarization. The effect of pulse current and direct current under simulated conditions for the well casing cathodic protection was investigated. The results indicate that under the simulated casing condition, Pulse Current Cathodic Protection(PCCP) system has better protection effect than Direct Current Cathodic Protection(DCCP) system under the same power output condition, and consumption of current is less than DCCP system. In addition, the influence of middle range of the duty ratio and frequency on the cathodic protection effect is determined.

articleTitle: A Study on the Spatial and Temporal Distribution of Population in Yunnan Province Based on BigDate
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Based on the data collected from the fourth, fifth and sixth census of administrative units at county level in Yunnan Province, the temporal and spatial distribution of its population is studied and analyzed with the spatial analysis function of ArcGIS and the method of geostatistics. The normal distribution of population density data is explored and analyzed with the help of histogram, normal QQ chart and Voronoi chart. From the results, it can be found that the population distribution of Yunnan Province is not balanced. The population distribution of central Yunnan, mainly in Kunming, is concentrated, while the population distribution is relatively concentrated in northeast and Southeast Yunnan and relatively sparse in northwest and Southwest Yunnan.

articleTitle: A Permanent Magnetic Brushless Generator with Magnetic Circuit Control
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: at present, the permanent magnet alternator on the market switches the working state according to the charging and discharging conditions of the battery. It uses the electronic switch to cut off the load of the generator to stop charging the battery. This method makes the generator in no-load state, which will not only reduce the fuel efficiency of the engine, but also have potential harm to the body electrical system. at overcoming the high cost of the scheme mentioned in the paper "Design of Permanent magnet brushless automobile alternator with electromagnetic clutch" of using electromagnetic clutch to switch the power transmission route between engine and generatorin so as to control the working state of automobile permanent magnet brushless generator. In order to control the magnetic circuit of the rotor and transfer the power, a design scheme of permanent magnet brushless generator with magnetic circuit control is designed. The intelligent control unit composed of single-chip microcomputer is used to collect the voltage data of generator and battery to control the brake electromagnet. This not only controls the working state of the generator, but also improves the fuel efficiency of the engine. This scheme reduces the cost of working state control of automobile permanent magnet brushless generator. and the relative position of left and right claw poles is controlled by electromagnet to realize the control of rotor magnetic circuit and then control the working state of generator. This scheme reduces the cost of working state control of automobile permanent magnet brushless generator. The test performance of the prototype is good.

articleTitle: Dynamic Password Authentication Method Based on Vehicle Command and Dispatch System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With superior flexibility, mobility, ease of use and integration, vehicle-mounted command and scheduling system has irreplaceable advantages in emergency and disaster relief, military command, urban management, border patrol and other fields. The current system login authentication and scheduling of each dispatching terminal control depend on dialogue with the information interaction and communication between the scheduling server, if the scheduling server software and hardware failures or offline, the entire vehicle scheduling command system will lose key scheduling command center is paralyzed, and all vehicle terminal equipment will not be able to certification and control scheduling. Aiming at this problem, this paper proposes a dynamic password authentication server without center node type method, when the vehicle scheduling command system scheduling server cannot be included in the communication network, can be either car terminal equipment as scheduling server starts the server program, quickly and play the function of the center node, a certified instructions parsing, dynamic instruction generation and dynamic matching certification process for each terminal equipment, such as identity authentication and scheduling control, effective guarantee the stability of the vehicle scheduling command system operation.

articleTitle: An Optimized New Metropolitan Area Network Architecture Design
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Metropolitan Area Network generally is the network that provides various information services within a city. The traditional metropolitan area networks BRAS is faced with such problems as high cost of data access equipment, mismatch of control and forwarding capabilities, poor scalability, difficulty in management and operation, unbalanced resource utilization, high cost of capacity expansion, etc. Based on the analysis of the current situation of traditional MAN, a new VBRAS design framework for MAN was suggested in this paper. Firstly, based on the overview of design framework of Metropolitan Area Network, the New VBRAS framework of MAN was designed. Secondly, MAN core DC management architecture was analyzed. Finally, The basic planning of load balance, fault protection and Vxlan for MAN was made.

articleTitle: Research on the Risk and Supervision Method of Big Data Application in Financial Field
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the possible risks in the application of big data in the financial field, this paper proposes a new supervision method based on big data. This method is based on big data, constructs the application platform of financial big data, and carries on the real-time mining to the massive big data in the financial field. The results show that this method can not only break the problem of data island, improve the security of personal privacy data, but also promote the standardization of big data.

articleTitle: Finite Element Modeling and Seismic Response Analysis of Pile Slab Structure
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Pile slab subgrade is a new type of subgrade structure proposed in recent years. Compared with soil subgrade, it has the advantages of small settlement, large overall stiffness and high smoothness. In this paper, a three-dimensional finite element model of pile slab subgrade is established by using SAP2000, which is a large-scale finite element analysis software. Three E1 seismic waves and three E2 seismic waves are respectively generated according to the horizontal design response spectra of E1 and E2 horizontal earthquakes by the way of artificial generation of time history waves. The seismic responses of three waves under the action of E1 and E2 earthquakes are compared. Through XTRACR analysis software, the ability of key section of pier is analyzed. Comparing the variation of the bending resistance of the section of the pile-slab subgrade structure with prestressed steel bars and non-prestressed steel bars, some useful conclusions are obtained.

articleTitle: Application of Regional Building Energy Consumption Prediction Model in Building Construction
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Energy consumption prediction model is very important in building construction. It is necessary for the construction process to have a good calculation method to predict the cost and energy consumption of the building in the presence of various factors (construction equipment, envelope structure and meteorological factors, etc.). But how to better measure the energy consumption of regional buildings is the focus of our concern. First and foremost, the calculation must be based on single buildings, and then the model must be precisely constructed. For the energy consumption problem of residential structures in different regions, the relationship between energy consumption of regional buildings and its influencing factors can be deduced by combining the building principles and the results of bottom-up model and correlation analysis. The essence of the bottom-up model is to build on the problem of energy consumption of regional buildings and direct and indirect effects are taken as causes and sub-causes respectively, then combined with their relationship coefficients, the relevant relationship coefficients are finally obtained. Through the construction of a variety of prediction models to analyze the energy consumption of regional buildings and detailed analysis of the inherent technical advantages and disadvantages. In the process of repeated combing and summarizing the reasonable application to the process of building construction, which can provide some valuable theoretical basis for the construction and solve various uncertainties in the prediction, to lay a certain solid foundation for further research in the future.

articleTitle: Research on the Accurate Identification Method of College Students with Financial Difficulties Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to realize the accurate identification of college students with financial difficulties, this paper puts forward a novel identification method of college students with financial difficulties based on big data. This method is based on big data technology and uses the factor evaluation method to mine the family data, students' personal data and the fluctuation data of students' family economy. The research results show that this method has higher recognition accuracy and can effectively reduce the work intensity of subsidized staff in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Network Visualization Technology in the Health Care of Traditional Chinese Medicine
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Traditional Chinese medicine health and rehabilitation system is the effective integration of traditional Chinese medicine health and rehabilitation and modern information technology, with the help of information technology to carry forward the concept and means of Chinese medicine health and rehabilitation. In order to introduce more about the modern health care and rehabilitation of traditional Chinese medicine, this paper comprehensively summarizes the application of multimedia technology in the health care and rehabilitation teaching of traditional Chinese medicine, the application of database technology, network technology and management information system in the actual health care and rehabilitation of traditional Chinese medicine, and provides the dynamic visualization of the health care data mining results of traditional Chinese medicine according to the process of data collection, data analysis and data display implementation. The scheme can generate interactive and scalable dynamic visual force map, thus providing a new and available tool for the research of Chinese medicine health preservation.

articleTitle: Research on DC Motor Driver in Automobile Electric Power Steering System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of unstable working voltage control of DC motor driver module, low frequency of speed regulating switch, conduction and cut-off delay of FET, a design method of DC motor driver for automotive electric power steering system is proposed. The relationship formula between armature voltage and motor output torque are determined by the mathematical modeling method of equivalent circuit and armature voltage control method, and the corresponding armature voltage and current values under different torque output are calculated. The switching frequency of the system is obtained by the relationship between the current value and the rotating speed. The test results show that the driver designed according to the research scheme can work stably in the current environment of 30a with the cooperation of radiator, and the output voltage of DC drive module is stable under the condition of high, medium and low PWM duty cycle, the power loss is small, the direction change control is fast, the drive current is large, the switching frequency can be adjusted in a large range, and it can match different types of medium and high power DC Motor, fully meet the requirements of the system.

articleTitle: Tumor Diagnosis Assistant System Design Based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Based on the research of data extraction and mining technology of tumor electronics, this paper designs a set of auxiliary diagnosis of test results based on test data mining combined with clinical treatment standards, to improve the diagnostic accuracy and diagnostic efficiency of the system. In this scheme, the reliability and validity of the system are verified by the data mining, model building and report interpretation of carcinoembryonic antigen by using the auxiliary diagnosis system of laboratory medicine and the data of tumor diseases. The system designed in this paper is based on the test results and diagnostic standards, with big data mining, the characteristics of humanization, intelligence and integration, to meet the actual needs of the actual work and achieve the expected design effect.

articleTitle: Study on Mitigation Performance of Hyperboloid Spherical Seismic Isolation Bearing for Long-Span High-Speed Railway Continuous Girder Bridge
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Taking the long-span high-speed railway continuous girder bridge with the main span of 128m in China as an example, a reasonable finite element analysis bridge model adopting hyperboloid spherical seismic isolation bearings is established. Using nonlinear dynamic time history analysis method, the seismic mitigation performance of the bearings on high-speed railway bridges is studied. The parameters of the seismic isolation bearing, including the friction coefficient of the sliding surface and the radius of curvature, are optimized. Numerical analysis results show that: (1) Hyperboloid spherical seismic isolation bearings provide very good mitigation effect. (2)The bending moment at the bottom of the main pier and the displacement of the pier top both decrease first and then increase with the increase of the friction coefficient. The shear force at the bottom of the pier and the pier-beam relative displacement both decrease with the increase of the friction coefficient; The internal forces of the side pier bottom, the displacement of the pier top and the relative pier-beam displacement both decrease with the increase of the friction coefficient. (3)The internal force and the top displacement of each pier have a tendency to increase slowly with the increase of the radius of curvature. The change value is not obvious, and the pier-beam relative displacement increases with the increase of the radius of curvature. The bearing parameters should be determined both on the numerical analysis results and the requirements of the bearing structure size.

articleTitle: Research on Map Matching Algorithm Based on Moving Trajectory of Underground Personnel
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the interference problems such as the double positioning of the antenna and the non-line-of-sight error caused by the mutual occlusion of the personnel vehicles in the current substation precise positioning substation, we proposed a map matching algorithm based on the received signal strength (RSS) and historical movement trajectory. Firstly, according to the received power intensity formula, the RSS value of the two antennas corresponding to the tag can be calculated easily. The relative direction of the tag and the antenna is determined, and the measured value of the tag is obtained according to the TOF (time of flight). Then use the least squares method to fit a historical moving trajectory curve of the label to obtain a predicted coordinate. According to the strength of the current signal, the coordinates of the appropriate size are used for coordinate fusion, and finally the corrected coordinate values are obtained. Compared with the direct ranging method, the algorithm has gained 10% in direction judgment accuracy and clearly removed the error caused by the RSS.

Author Keywords: Map Matching , RSS, Least squares, Polynomial interpolation method

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Prefabricated Prestressed Bridge Piers Based on Fiber Beam Element
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Prefabrication of bridge structure is an important development direction of bridge construction. A large number of on-site construction operations are completed in advance in prefabricated factories, which can reduce the cost of maintenance of bridge construction. Based on the fiber beam element model, the secondary development and application of concrete and steel hysteretic constitutive models are carried out to better analyze the seismic behavior of prefabricated prestressed piers. On the basis of the existing literature, a reliable one-cycle hysteretic constitutive model of reinforced concrete materials was selected, and the existing prestressed reinforced concrete bridge piers were numerically simulated, and the load-displacement curves and quasi-static experiments were carried out. Comparative analysis demonstrates the feasibility of the constitutive model of reinforced concrete materials, as well as higher calculation accuracy and completion efficiency.

articleTitle: Reconstruction Design of Urban Buildings in Historical Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Every town has its own character, some are passionate, some are peaceful, but they should not be the same. In the past 20 years, with the continuous development of urbanization, many historical towns have also ushered in a new life. In order to seek better urban development and provide a better living environment for residents, people have demolished some old and old buildings in the town and built fashionable houses. The living environment may have improved, but the characteristics of the town have gradually become blurred and gradually absorbed. Urban development and environmental remediation must be done. But how to deal with it better, the author discusses this problem through the reconstruction of abandoned primary school in Xiaoshan village, Conghua.

articleTitle: Influence of Shield Tunneling Construction on Formation and Existing Tunnel Deformation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In recent years, the construction of urban subways in China has grown rapidly, which has led to the emergence of undercutting projects under existing tunnels. This paper takes the tunnel of the existing subway line 1 under the shield tunnel of Sanshanjie Station to Chaotiangong Station of Nanjing Metro Line 5 as the engineering background. Dynamic simulation of the double-line shield tunneling process was carried out using the finite element software Midas-GTS NX. It is revealed that the deformation of the stratum and existing tunnels is affected by the construction of shield tunnels. The results show that when the shield tunnel is under the existing tunnel, the stratum and the existing tunnel will produce large uneven settlement. At the same time, a large horizontal displacement is generated for the existing tunnel, thereby causing torsional deformation of the tunnel. This phenomenon will seriously affect the safety of tunnel operations. Therefore, this paper proposes to strengthen the stratum of the intersecting area of the two tunnels.

articleTitle: Analysis of Dynamic Characteristics of Long-Span Railway Extradosed Bridge
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to ensure the safety and reliability of the mechanical performance of the whole bridge in the operation stage of the completed bridge, this paper takes an Extradosed bridge, Panzhihua Jinshajiang bridge of Chengdu-Kunming Railway, as the research background, analyzes and studies the longitudinal resonance dynamic characteristics of the short tower cable-stayed bridge structure when the train load acts on the main beam under the condition of completed bridge. The longitudinal vibration of the main girder caused by live load will directly affect the safety and use of the expansion joint device at the abutment, and the damage of the expansion device will lead to the safety and reliability of vehicles in the later operation stage. The dynamic response of the structure caused by the different speed of live load is analyzed. The results show that when there is no significant difference between the live load action speed and the estimated longitudinal bridge resonance speed, there is no significant difference between the longitudinal bridge loading frequency when the live load passes through the bridge and the first-order longitudinal vibration frequency of the bridge. A longitudinal resonance phenomenon can be observed in Jinshajiang bridge, in which the dynamic response of the main beam and the main tower is obvious.

articleTitle: Seismic Fragility Analysis of Simply Supported Beam Bridges with Precast Columns
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The fragility analysis of simply supported beam bridges with precast columns was conducted using nonlinear time history analysis based on probability theory. The precast column featuring with flag shape hysteresis lateral force-displacement response was used here aiming to alleviate the substructure damage during earthquake. Peak ground acceleration (PGA) was selected as seismic intensity measure (IM). The finite element model used nonlinear beam-column element for substructures, and used elastic beam element for super beams. Rubber bearings were modeled with nonlinear bearing element. The interaction between adjacent beams, abutment and beam, and abutment and backfill soil were modeled with various appropriate nonlinear elements. Four bridge limit states are considered: slight, moderate, extensive and complete damage. The capacity limits were derived from empirical results suggested by literature with minor revisions. The uncertainty of the excitation ground motion and structural material strengths, such as steel bar and concrete, was considered. Twenty seismic waves were selected from PEER STRONG MOTION DATABASE. The probabilistic seismic demands of components, such as the piers curvature ductility, abutment active and passive displacement, and bearing displacement, were estimated. The component fragility were drawn using the probabilistic seismic demand model (PSDM). At last the fragility curves of the whole bridge was derived by the combination fragility of the components.

articleTitle: Data Visualization for Making Sense of Scientific Literature
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that it is difficult for beginners to obtain information effectively when facing the visual design of scientific literature, this paper puts forward a visual design and analysis framework of scientific literature. By analyzing the attributes of existing scientific literature visualization design, such as chart type, interactivity, layout and label, the framework obtains the potential impact of scientific literature visualization design on audience understanding. At the same time, this method also puts forward the corresponding design strategy by making use of the properties of visual design tools, combined with the current situation of literature co-citation network visualization design. The research results show that the existing visual design of scientific literature can improve the readability and interpretability of visual design through interactive visualization and adaptive layout adjustment.

articleTitle: New Employee Student Repast Big Data Analysis Research Application
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: with the continuous improvement of information construction, the vast majority of colleges and universities in China have begun to build digital campus, the construction of all teachers and students and school administrators have brought great convenience. With the construction of digital campus, colleges and universities will produce massive data every day, among which the data generated by students account for a large proportion. The data generated by students include scores, information on borrowing books, credit card information of dormitory access control and consumption data of campus one-card. By analyzing the behavioral data generated by students, some behavioral characteristics of students in school are found, which can provide a more scientific basis for the management of students. This paper makes use of the data such as the achievement information of students in a vocational college and the consumption information of campus one-card. Firstly, the original data is preprocessed so that the processed data can meet the basic requirements of data analysis. Then, the data after preprocessing is discretized with the data discretization technology so that the data can meet the requirements of the Apriori algorithm of association rules. Finally, Apriori algorithm is used to mine the correlation between students' academic performance and campus one-card consumption data.

articleTitle: Finite Element Modeling and Dynamic Mode Characteristics of Pile-Slab Structure
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Pile-type subgrade is a new type of subgrade structure proposed in recent years, compared with the soil roadbed, it has the advantages of small post-construction settlement, high overall rigidity and high smoothness. This article combines the design example of pile-type roadbed engineering, considering the nonlinearity of the structure, establishing a three-dimensional finite element model of a pile-slab subgrade using large-scale finite element analysis software SAP2000. The space beam unit is used to simulate the pier column, the board unit simulates the bridge deck, and the bridge pier and the bridge deck are simulated by BODY. Dynamic analysis of the model in order to get some useful conclusions.

articleTitle: Patent Protection for Artificial Intelligence in Europe
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to increase the possibility of patent entitled of artificial intelligence related inventions at the European Patent Office, applications should focus on what technical problems the invention are solving or identify the specific technical improvements. From the perspective of patent analysis, European artificial intelligence technology is leading the world and in this field, the European Patent Office is one of the most important intellectual property offices, and its legislation and practice of patent eligibility examination for artificial intelligence related Inventions have an important impact on the world. the European Patent Office takes the position in the Guidelines that artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies are based on mathematical methods and are therefore generally excluded from patent eligibility unless linked to a technical application. The updated Guidelines did not make substantial changes to the "technical " requirements of the patent eligible subject, but only further clarified and refined it.

articleTitle: An Innovative Risk Evaluation Model for Undergraduate New Entrepreneurship
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Based on the process of enterprise risk management, a large sample survey was carried out on the current status of non-systematic risks of new start-ups in universities in China, and different types of risks were analyzed in depth from risk identification, risk decision-making and risk control. This paper points out that the new venture risk source in colleges and universities is a multi-dimensional and multi-level risk source system, which mainly includes three levels: the external environmental risk source, the internal system risk source, and the innovative project risk source. Based on this, combined with the characteristics of new start-up companies in colleges and universities, we built a risk-breaking innovation risk transmission network for enterprises. Finally, the concept of risk threshold for new entrepreneurship in colleges and universities is put forward, and the evolution mechanism of new entrepreneurial risk system in colleges and universities is analzsed. The study found that: Currently, the non-system risk faced by start-up companies is ranked as capital risk, market risk, management risk and technology risk. Second, there are certain differences in the level of control of venture companies for different types of risks. The article puts forward some feasible suggestions for the current situation of risk management for start-up companies.

articleTitle: An Improved Cellular Automaton with Unfixed Length Cell for Traffic Load Effect Analysis of Bridge
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In view of the problem of insufficient accuracy of traditional cellular automata in simulating traffic flow, STCA is improved from the aspects of cell definition and evolution rules, and a cellular automaton with unfixed length cell is proposed. The proposed cellular automaton can accurately simulate the vehicle geometry size and axle distribution on the bridge and generate reasonable simulated traffic flow. In this paper, the traffic load effect analysis of 200 m span virtual simply supported beam is carried out by using unfixed length cellular automaton, and the results are compared with those of STCA. The results show that the accuracy of the proposed cellular automaton is higher.

articleTitle: Experimental Study and Finite Element Analysis on Stress Transfer Mechanism of Retard-Bonded Prestressed Concrete Beams
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to study the stress transfer mechanism of the retard-bonded prestressed concrete beams, a retard-bonded prestressed concrete beam is selected as the test monitoring object in the project site to find the stress change rule of the concrete in the monitoring process, and the stress transfer mechanism of the test beam concrete is obtained, which is compared with the traditional prestressed concrete structure. The finite element analysis software ANSYS is used to model the test beam, simulate the test beam in the stage of tension and bond hardening of slow binder, and compare with the test results. At the same time, simulate the stress of the test beam in the normal use process, analyze the dangerous section of the test beam and prevent in advance.

Author Keywords: retard-bonded prestress, transfer mechanism, finite element method

articleTitle: Performance Based Seismic Design of Precast Segmental Column Bridges and Quasi-Static Cyclic Test
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The performance-based seismic design (PBSD) permits the structure to be designed according to owners requirement to achieve the desired damage state under an earthquake event with specific return period. Though this method is not new, the present PBSD procedures are mostly subjective, qualitative, and partial probability. In order to reduce the gap between the PSBD method and the current design practice, the process of PBSD was investigated. The proposed PBSD process includes four steps, e.g. seismic hazard analysis, structural analysis, damage analysis and loss analysis. The whole procedure is full probability, considering the uncertainty or variability of strength and demand distribution. The implementation of each step was summarized. For the length limited, the detailed process, such as structural probability analysis and damage estimation empirical regression were not provided. At last the quasi-static cyclic test of two precast segmental columns were presented, in which the damage states were recorded and defined.

articleTitle: Appearance Detection Method of Resistance Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The appearance defect detection of resistances is the last procedure of the production line, which has an important impact on product quality. The method of manually detecting a large number of resistance has the disadvantages of low efficiency and poor reliability, studies have shown that the size of the data set has a decisive impact on the performance of the deep learning-based method, and small data sets usually produce an overfitting phenomenon. In view of these problems, the paper design the overall structure of the appearance detection method of resistances with generative adversarial neural network enhanced data set, and appearance detection method of resistances based on deep learning is proposed. First, input the predicted resistance image, perform prediction through the established convolutional neural network model, and finally output its result. The test results show that compared with the original data set, the AUC value of the model trained by the enhanced data set is improved by 2% ~ 4%, with an accuracy of 97.9%, and can deal with 6 kinds of appearance defects of the resistance.

articleTitle: Block Chain Digital Invoice System Risk Assessment and System Development Research
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In view of the tax problems existing in the current electronic invoices, such as "overstatement, false declaration, false invoice", etc., a new method for checking the authenticity of electronic invoices is proposed by using the block chain technology. The risk of the existing electronic invoice system is evaluated by using artificial intelligence automatic identification technology and graphic image processing technology. The results show that the method adopted is efficient, safe and fair, avoids waste of calculation effort, and is suitable for block chain transactions with large-scale invoice tracing and reimbursement records.

Author Keywords: Block chain, digital invoice, graphic image analysis and processing, CRC, OpenCV

articleTitle: Analyze the Aging Degree of Optical Cable in Accordance with the Change Degree of the Received Optical Power
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper designs an automatic monitoring technology for the aging of optical cables, and introduces and compares the traditional methods for the aging of optical cables and the automatic monitoring technology for the aging of optical cables. The automatic monitoring technology has the functions of early warning of the aging of optical cables, positioning of specific aging optical cables and analysis of the deterioration trend of optical cables. This system determines the aging degree of optical cable by comparing and analyzing the monitoring data. It can not only discover the aging section of optical cable in time, but also discover the aging section of optical cable in advance, eliminate the hidden trouble caused by the aging of optical cable, and improve the reliability of optical fiber communication system.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction Mode of Intelligent Traffic Safety Integration Under the Background of Intelligent City
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the construction of intelligent traffic safety integration under the background of intelligent city, this paper puts forward a novel intelligent traffic safety integration construction mode based on a variety of advanced information technologies. Based on the Internet of things technology, cloud computing technology, artificial intelligence technology and big data technology, this model can mine and analyze the data related to intelligent traffic safety integration under the background of smart city. The research results show that this model can scientifically control traffic signals, achieve traffic guidance, and promote the construction and development of intelligent cities.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Active Finance on Household Consumption Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Under the influence of slowing economic growth and other factors, the growth rate of China's household consumption has been declining. Fiscal and taxation policies are an important means of regulating residents 'income. Levying more taxes and fees on links with lower production efficiency will increase residents' actual income and have a positive impact on the consumer market. How to judge the level of production efficiency has long been the subject of controversy in the economic field. Based on the data of all 30 provinces, this article uses the return on investment as the main basis for judging production efficiency. Based on the analysis of consumer demand, this paper proposes specific ways to optimize fiscal and taxation policies. Measures such as reducing the tax of small and medium-sized enterprises and increasing the threshold for individual taxes should be adopted to increase the actual income of residents, which will help promote the growth of residents' consumption

articleTitle: Extraction of Thermos Cup Contour Based on Optimized Edge Feature and Line Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the main contour of thermos cups is hard extracted in complex backgrounds, a method, which combines feature extraction and integration of line detection, is proposed. The Faster-RCNN deep neural network optimized by resnet50 is used first to perform preliminary extraction of the thermos cup region in the image. The anisotropic diffusion filtering based on the improvement of gradient contrast is proposed to solve the interference texture in the extracted region, which can effectively suppress textures based on contour preservation. By analyzing the contour characteristics of the thermos cup, the Hough straight line detection algorithm based on the two-way three-neighborhood grouping and the least square are used to extract contours. The results indicate that this method can effectively extract the main contour of the thermos cup in different scenes.

articleTitle: Research on Fire Extinguishing Behavior of Bubble Atomizing Nozzle in Metro Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: According to the mechanism of bubble atomization, the author developed a fully transparent bubble atomizer with quartz glass. Taking the Shenyang metro as the engineering background, the simulation test of comparison and fire suppression of 5 aviation kerosene fire and wood stacking fire in the "limited" space of the carriage, the gas pressure of 1.3Mpa and the water pressure of 0.9Mpa are studied. To begin with, the water droplet quality is replaced by the weighing method into the existing contour map Origin, and the fog flux distribution map of the fog field is obtained. Furthermore, the authenticity of the fog flux distribution is proved in the fire extinguishing test, and the temperature around the flame is introduced by the thermocouple. Last but not least, the smoke was analyzed by using the smoke (gas) tester and the practicability and reliability of the water mist system which would be further verified. The results show that the water mist field is uniform under this condition, the fire temperature and smoke irritation are obviously improved under the action of fine water mist, and it is safe to use nitrogen in practical application.

articleTitle: Study on Impact Resistance of Urban Prefabricated Bridge Piers Under Vehicle Impact Loadings
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to investigate the failure mechanism and impact resistance of prefabricated bridge piers under vehicle impact loadings, the key technology incorporated in the numerical simulation for predicting vehicle collisions the behavior of prefabricated bridge piers subject to is discussed. A case study based on the Jiamin Viaduct is conducted by numerical simulations, during which the impact resistance of piers corresponding to three types of connections, i.e. grouting sleeve connection pier, socket connection prefabricated pier and cast-in-place pier, are compared. The results indicate that all piers are observed in shear-flexure failure type. The impact resistance of prefabricated piers is slightly worse than that of cast-in-place piers. It is recommended that the position of grouting sleeve be arranged at the bottom of pier, and the socket connection component needs sufficient embedding depth.

articleTitle: Study on Seismic Behavior of Single Tower Cable-Stayed Bridge with Overload Yield Bearing in High-Intensity Regions
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to study the seismic isolation bearing problem of the single tower cable-stayed bridge under earthquake action, the seismic performance of the bridge is improved at the conceptual design stage. For the overload yield bearing, a single tower cable-stayed bridge in the high intensity area is taken as the research object. The full-bridge three-dimensional finite element model was established by SAP2000 spatial structure analysis and design program. The pile-soil interaction was considered, the vertical joint of the pylon was simulated, and the structural natural vibration characteristics, response spectrum and nonlinear seismic response time history analysis were carried out. meanwhile, the influence of the shear of bearing on the natural vibration period and seismic response of single-tower cable-stayed bridge is also studied in this paper. The results show that under the nonlinear time history analysis, the bearing will be sheared under the E1 probability. After the shear, the structural period is prolonged, the seismic response of the auxiliary pier and the side pier is greatly improved and the plastic hinge can be avoided. Under the E1 probability and the E2 probability, considering the shear of the bearing, the seismic response of each main component of the structure is smaller than the ultimate bending moment of the section, and the damping effect is good. The research results show that the overload yield bearing has a high promotion value and can provide reference for the seismic design of the same type of bridge.

articleTitle: Seismic Performance Test and Fem Analysis of Assembled Concrete Pier with Grouting Sleeve and Steel Tube Shear Connector
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Compared with the traditional integral cast-in-place piers, the assembled piers have many advantages. In order to study the seismic performance of the new fabricated concrete piers with the nested connection of steel pipes, the overall design of the cast-in-place, traditional grouting sleeves and new steel pipes is designed. The seismic performance of three types of piers was studied. The horizontal low-cycle repeated load tests of three square pier specimens were carried out. The hysteresis curves, skeleton curves, ductility, energy consumption, strength degradation, stiffness degradation and deformation recovery of the members were tested. The performance and laws of the other aspects were studied and compared. The results show that the overall bearing capacity of the existing cast-in-place pier is closer than that of the new type of prefabricated pier. The hysteresis curve is full, the failure mode is the overall compression and failure, the displacement ductility and cumulative energy dissipation capacity are slightly better, and the residual displacement is small. The stiffness is less degraded, has good seismic performance and does not show significant strength degradation.

articleTitle: Research on Control Method of Intelligent Air-Conditioning System in Smart City
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to realize the intellectualization of intelligent urban air-conditioning system, this paper puts forward a novel control method of intelligent air-conditioning system based on a variety of advanced science and technology. This method integrates a variety of advanced science and technology, such as big data technology, cloud computing technology, Internet of things technology and so on. The research results show that this method can fundamentally scientifically and effectively improve the stability and safety of air-conditioning operation, and achieve the goal of energy saving and green development.

articleTitle: Research on Reconstruction of Emergency Decision-Making System Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to realize the application of big data technology in emergency decision-making system reconstruction, a novel emergency decision-making system reconstruction method based on big data technology is proposed in this paper. This method is based on big data technology and can mine all kinds of data generated by the emergency decision-making system. The research results show that this method can fundamentally improve the emergency decision-making system and improve the efficiency of emergency decision-making in our country.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Anchorage Performance of Large Diameter Plain Round CFRP Tendon Compressed Anchor
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The large-diameter plain round CFRP tendon has a smooth surface, high bearing capacity and is difficult to anchor. To investigate the anchoring performance of mechanically clamped anchors on this type of tendon, researchers studied the anchoring performances of CFRP tendon wedges and compressed anchors. In this paper, CFRP tendon wedge type and compressed type anchors were designed and fabricated, and their anchoring performances were compared and tested. Three kinds of test pieces were made for each type of anchor. The tendons required for the test were plain round CFRP tendons with a diameter of 12.7 mm. The test results show that the wedge anchor has a poor clamping effect on the plain round CFRP tendon with a diameter of 12.7mm, and the CFRP tendon and the wedge will slip. The small deformation formed inside the compressed anchor will directly engage the surface of the CFRP tendon, which will improve the anchoring performance, but at the same time it will damage the surface of the CFPR tendon. The clamping effect is relatively good, reaching about 76% tensile strength of the CFRP tendon. To further improve the anchoring performance, researchers could cover the surface of the CFRP tendon with a protective sleeve.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction and Application of Desktop Virtual Reality Teaching System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The new mode of combining desktop virtual reality teaching system with traditional teaching is a new means of teaching, which breaks through the limitation of traditional teaching in time and space. This paper analyzes the feasibility and key technologies of the desktop virtual reality teaching system, and proposes the technical scheme and modeling of the desktop virtual reality teaching system that is feasible in the modern computer course teaching, and discusses the design and implementation of a desktop virtual reality teaching system with three-dimensional object display, three-dimensional space display and virtual scene construction. In this paper, a new stereo image generation algorithm is proposed, which is used to realize the technical scheme of the system. The abstraction of the complete virtual reality system is summarized into the physical geometry module, the scene module and the function module, etc. The texture mapping technology and the tree-structured scene modeling technology are applied to the solid geometry modeling and scene modeling of the virtual environment, and the resource occupancy of the system is controlled to a lower level while creating the virtual environment realism.

articleTitle: Research Progress on Structural Damage Identification in Civil Engineering
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Structural damage identification has been a focus of civil engineering research in recent years. Therefore, this paper focuses on the advantages and disadvantages of various damage identification methods, including model updates, genetic algorithms, neural networks, support vector machines, dynamic fingerprints, wavelet transformations, and the Hilbert-Huang transform. This paper also discusses the latest research on damage identification combined with building information modeling (BIM) and deep learning. Finally, it is demonstrated that comparing the accuracy of different machine learning algorithms for damage identification and obtaining the optimal algorithm will become an important research direction in the future.

articleTitle: Energy-Based Seismic Design of Viscous Dampers for Long Span Bridges
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Current design practices of seismic resistant viscous damper for long span bridges relay on experience and iterative methods. To eliminate the possible prevailing inaccuracy and to reduce tedious iterative calculations, an innovative method of seismic optimal design is deduced based on the energy principle with the help of two generalized Euler function sand also considering the tower bending moment as the minimum target value. This paper introduces the application of the proposed method in the design of seven super large cable-stayed bridges. The research showed that there is positive relationship between the nonlinear viscous damping coefficient and linear damping coefficient. When the maximum velocity Vmax is less than 1 m/s, the ratio of both variables monotonically increases with the velocity exponent in a non-linear relationship. The maximum damping force is linear with the velocity exponent while using different optimization solutions. Idea of using the minimum velocity exponent and minimum damping coefficient is considered as the most reasonable optimal solution for the seismic design by keeping the minimum velocity exponent value limited to 0.2 to avoid practical complications.

articleTitle: Review of Ecological Coast Construction Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: the coastal zone is a zone where the ocean and the land meets, which is also the "life belt" of today's human social and economic development. Due to the impact of global climate change, the ecological environment of the coastal zone is seriously threatened. This paper briefly describes the corresponding regulations of ecological coastal management at home and abroad, and summarizes the relevant engineering technologies of ecological coastal construction. It is hoped to provide a reliable basis for the vigorous development of ecological coastal construction projects, thus further promoting marine ecological civilization in coastal areas construction. By summarizing the technical means commonly used in the practice of ecological coastal construction projects at home and abroad in recent years, it is proposed that the future ecological coastal construction technology should focus on the following aspects: 1) ecological coastal protection technology; 2) artificial protection technology; 3) landscape construction and protection technology; 4) Ecological engineering technology.

articleTitle: The Relationship Between the Construction of Smart City and Residents' Subjective Well-Being: An Empirical Analysis Based on CFPS and CGSS Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Based on CFPS, CGSS and government public open data, this paper establishes an evaluation system to assess smart city construction. Ordinary least square model (OLS model) and Ordered Probit model are used to explore the impact of smart city construction on residents' subjective well-being and gender difference from the perspective of humanism. The results show that the construction of smart city has a significantly positive impact on residents' well-being, while it affects the subjective well-being of male residents more than that of the female. By further establishing the mediation effect model to analyze the effect mechanism of smart city construction on residents' well-being, it is found that residents' income plays a partially mediating role in the influence of smart city construction on residents' subjective well-being.

articleTitle: Shortage of Water Resources in Jaffna Peninsula of Sri Lanka
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With elaborate reviews and on-site investigations, this paper systematically depicts the water resource status of Jaffna Peninsula from perspectives of both lagoon water and groundwater. The main problems that local government faced in water resources development and utilization process are heterogeneity of rainfall time and lack of water resource management measures, which lead to difficulties in rainwater harvesting/utilization, seawater intrusion and rising problems of water pollution. A water crisis has derived from above issues and severely restrains the local development. Therefore, an integrated water resources management plan is extremely urgent for Jaffna Peninsula.

articleTitle: The Future Direction of Bridge Seismic Research - Intelligence and Resilience
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Bridge is the hinge of transportation system and the important component of lifeline project. the seismic research on which has always been the focus of attention. In recent years, advances in science and technology and changes in design concepts have also brought about innovations in seismic design of bridges. Firstly, in the actual stages of design, operation, maintenance, the work will become more efficient and the seismic performance of the actual bridge will be higher, showing a higher intelligence. Secondly, the seismic design also needs to take into account the recoverability after the earthquake, avoiding the long-term interruption of the function, that is, the resilience of the bridge seismic design. From these two perspectives, this paper reviews the history of bridge seismic research and the work to be improved. Finally, the future of bridge seismic research is rationally considered.

articleTitle: Diffraction of Cnoidal Waves Around a Large Vertical Elliptical Cylinder
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Based on the cnoidal wave theory, an analytical solution for the diffraction of cnoidal incident wave around a large elliptical cylinder in shallow water is derived in elliptical coordinates. Accordingly, the analytical expressions for the pressure and wave forces are obtained. In order to validate the analytical model, a numerical model for the diffraction of cnoidal incident wave around a large cylinder with an arbitrary cross-section is also developed using finite element method, where the whole fluid domain is divided into bounded and unbounded domain. The exact artificial boundary condition is introduced to model the unbounded domain. The proposed numerical model is used to verify the present analytical solution for the cnoidal incident wave forces on the elliptical cylinder. Based on the present analytical solution, the detailed analysis on the cnoidal wave forces on elliptical cylinders are performed. It is found that the maximum dimensionless wave forces obtained by cnoidal wave theory are obviously larger than those obtained by small amplitude wave theory. Therefore, ocean engineers should consider the cnoidal wave forces in the design offshore structures with an elliptical cross-section in shallow water.

articleTitle: Research on Archives Database Construction Based on Heritage Protection in Ancient Towns of Yunnan
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Based on defining the concept and connotation of ancient town tourism destination on from the traditional regional geography study, describes the regional characteristics of Yunnan Province town and its pattern, and stage of development on the change of time and history. Tourism development is the first and best way to protect and utilize ancient town heritage as a starting point. In view of the relative deficiency of the evaluation index system of historic towns (villages) and national scenic tourist towns (villages), a comprehensive evaluation index system of heritage protection and tourism development was constructed. On this basis, we answered a number of ancient towns in Yunnan province. Which ancient towns are suitable for heritage protection and tourism development?. Combined with the classification and classification evaluation results and the construction of the theoretical model of comprehensive equilibrium analysis, the differential development path choice and the regional tourism pattern reconstruction of Yunnan ancient town were defined.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation Index of Rural Roads Development Level
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In view of the fact that there is no systematic evaluation method for the development level of rural roads, this paper puts forward an evaluation method for the development level of rural roads. On the basis of summarizing the current situation of rural roads development in China, this paper takes the county-level region as the evaluation object, systematically constructs the index system of rural roads development level evaluation from four aspects of construction, management, maintenance and operation, uses the analytic hierarchy process, and studies and formulates various evaluations. The evaluation criteria of indicators are to accurately, objectively and reasonably understand the development process of rural roads, master the development level of rural roads, and construct a set of evaluation methods for the development level of rural roads. To guide the high-quality development of county-level rural roads to provide work direction, also for all levels of transport departments to evaluate the development level of rural roads to provide reference standards.

Author Keywords: rural roads, development level, evaluation indicators, evaluation methods

articleTitle: Optimal IMs for Seismic Demand Modeling of Girder Bridges Subjected to Pulse-Like Ground Motions
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Recent efforts of fragility analysis of structures often pose a challenge in selecting optimal intensity measures (IMs) for ground motions. This paper proposes a general procedure for determining optimal IMs based on feature selection. Firstly, the statistical models, such as forward stepwise regression, principal component analysis and generalized linear regression, are presented in detail. Secondly, a total of 29 ground motion IMs are considered in the current research, and 139 ground motions with velocity pulses are selected from Pacific Earthquake Engineering Research Center database. Thirdly, the optimal IMs for the general regular girder bridges subjected to the selected ground motions are determined by feature selection. Finally, a case study is conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed method for optimal IMs selection. The numerical results reveal that the optimal IMs for regular girder bridges subjected to ground motions with velocity pulses are peak ground velocity (PGV), velocity spectrum intensity (VSI) and compound vel.-related IM ( ). In addition, the first principal component of the selected IMs can contain the most of the information, thus only the first principal component is enough to establish the PSDMs of the bridge components. The proposed general procedure for optimal IMs selection is applicable to other structures.

articleTitle: IHS for QoS Satisfaction Degree Based Web Service Composition Optimal Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To solve the problem of web service composition optimization, intelligent optimization algorithms have been used to get the optimal composition solution. Yet, most of the current work lacks consideration of users' subjective feelings. In this paper, the concept of QoS satisfaction degree is introduced to take the user's subjective feelings into consideration. And an optimal model is proposed for maximizing the user's QoS satisfaction degree based on the current QoS web service composition model. Besides, an improved harmony search algorithm (IHS) is prompted to solve the problem. Learning strategy is used in the fine-tuning operation of IHS, and a competition mechanism is introduced in the harmony library updating operation. IHS overcomes the disadvantages of the high random and non-directional searching process of the original harmony search algorithm. IHS and HS are applied in the experiments. Test results show that IHS can get better time efficiency and solution than the HS algorithm does.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Civil Engineering Experimental Teaching Management Platform in Mobile Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper explains the research and design of the experimental teaching system of civil engineering. Teachers, students and administrators can use this APP to access and manage teaching resources, and interact with each other in real time through interactive answering module. The system is mainly developed by Android Studio and it adopts the idea of layered design. It includes two bottom modules: network communication and message push, and five functional modules: experiment arrangement, job management, interactive question answering, user management and setting. After testing, the experimental teaching management system can meet the functional needs of users. The design of Android course teaching system provides a good reference for the development of similar courses, and achieves the expected development purpose.

Author Keywords: This paper explains the research and design of the experimental teaching system of civil engineering Teachers, students and administrators can use this APP to access and manage teaching resources, and interact with each other in real time through interactive answering module The system is mainly developed by Android Studio and it adopts the idea of layered design It includes two bottom modules: network communication and message push, and five functional modules: experiment arrangement, job management, interactive question answering, user management and setting After testing, the experimental teaching management system can meet the functional needs of users The design of Android course teaching system provides a good reference for the development of similar courses, and achieves the expected development purpose

articleTitle: Research on Building Data Acquisition Methods in Smart City
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
