abstract: In order to improve the accuracy and efficiency of building data acquisition in smart city, this paper proposes a novel building data acquisition method based on big data technology, Internet of things technology and cloud computing technology. This method mainly integrates computer-aided design technology, building information model technology and radio frequency identification technology, and uses case analysis to realize an efficient and scientific building data collection in a smart city. The research results show that this method can promote the efficiency and accuracy of building data collection in smart cities, and promote the leap from traditional buildings to intelligent buildings.

articleTitle: Research on Privacy Protection of Indoor Temperature Acquisition Based on MapReduce Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The privacy of indoor temperature acquisition system is protected, and the information encryption and secure storage ability of indoor temperature acquisition are improved to prevent data leakage. A privacy protection and anti-attack encryption algorithm of indoor temperature acquisition based on MapReduce model is proposed. The data structure model of privacy protection data in indoor temperature acquisition system is analyzed, the information coding model of indoor temperature data is constructed, and the random sequence analysis of privacy protection data is carried out by combining data vector quantification coding method. MapReduce model and fuzzy block encryption control method are used to improve the anti-attack encryption algorithm of privacy protection data in indoor temperature acquisition system. The simulation results show that the algorithm can resist leakage encryption of privacy protection data in indoor temperature acquisition system, enhance the randomness of key coding distribution of data, reduce the deciphering probability, improve the privacy protection ability of indoor temperature acquisition, reduce the risk of data leakage and attack, improve the privacy protection performance of data encryption, and have good application value in indoor temperature acquisition and information encryption.

articleTitle: Research on the Management Mode of Graduate Students in Colleges and Universities Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of postgraduate management and realize the modernization and intellectualization of postgraduate management mode, this paper puts forward a postgraduate management mode based on big data. This method is based on big data technology, collects students' personal learning situation, students' personal family situation, students' interests and hobbies, and realizes the optimization of management mode. The research results show that the management model has higher management efficiency, can realize the intellectualization of the management of postgraduates in colleges and universities, and improve the scientificalness and timeliness of the management of postgraduates in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Study on the Factors and Management Strategy of Traffic Block Incident on Hangzhou Province Highway
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Along with road traffic interruption caused by adverse weather, construction maintenance and other causes gradually occurred, people's demand for mobility information services is increasing, and more emphasis on the process of moving information services in the timeliness, reliability and convenience. Improving the emergency response and disposal ability of highway transportation has become more and more urgent. This paper proposed the category, spatial and time distribution model of the highway block incidents, showing the significance and application of statistics and analysis of national highway traffic blocking incidents data. Finally, as Hangzhou Province highway for example, the analysis are implemented to demonstrate the efficiency of the proposed approaches. The further suggestion is that the combined prevention, monitoring, travel routing and service of national highway traffic block incidents management system should be established in order to reduce the impact of traffic block incidents on highway network operation.

Author Keywords: highway block incident, Hangzhou Province highway network, block incident analysis, highway network management

articleTitle: A Summary of Studies on Main Factors of Earthquake Resistance of Urban Ramp Bridge
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the development of China's economy and society, the ramp bridge has appeared more and more in the urban road system and plays a very important role. The ramp bridge is limited by its function and site environment. Its structure is mostly inclined bridge, slope bridge and curved bridge. The undulation and stiffness of adjacent piers and adjacent spans are relatively large. The ramp bridge is more complicated and has many factors affecting its seismic performance. This paper intends to first summarize the stress characteristics of the interchange bridge and the typical tunnel bridge damage in recent years, and then mainly from the radius of curvature, longitudinal slope, span and wide span, ground motion input angle, bridge directly affecting the characteristics of the ramp structure. The constraint method and the support method are different, and finally the research focus on the future seismic research of the bridge is put forward.

Author Keywords: earthquake damage ground motion response of ramp bridge

articleTitle: Quantitative Analysis of Construction Site Risk and Threshold of the Early Warning System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper starts from definition of risk, considering the probability of accidents and the consequences, obtains the mathematical measurement of risk, and calculates the risk value of the construction site. The probability of risk event causing casualties is determined by UWB positioning technology, according to the position measure of the construction worker, the machinery and casualty loss measured by the compensation. The risk threshold and the real-time warning threshold are finally calculated to provide a basis for decision-making.

articleTitle: Multiscale Finite Element Model and Mechanical Analysis of a Cable-Stayed Bridge with Large Cantilever Spine Girder
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: A new bridge named Kongchenghe bridge that is going to be constructed in Anhui province uses the spine girder with large cantilever and adopts hybrid cable-stayed bridge structure. The design and property of a hybrid cable-stayed bridge is introduced and the characteristic of spine girder with large cantilever is discussed. The design concepts of the bridge is introduced and a multiscale finite element model is built in this work, through which the specific details of the bridge is shown, and the model is computed with combined load conditions. The results verify the efficiency of the finite element model and reveal important mechanical characteristics of the bridge.

articleTitle: Study on Construction Planning for Bridge Structure Based on BIM Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Bridge structure requires detailed construction planning before construction. The application of BIM technology has provided the possibility for the efficient construction of bridge structures. Construction planning used BIM technology for a newly-built bridge and a renovated bridge were given in this paper. BIM application results for different bridge states of new construction and renovation, such as bridge construction visualization, calculation check, oblique photography, and management platform integration were proposed respectively, which provide guidance for later construction of bridge structure.

articleTitle: Study on the Temporal and Spatial Variation of Phosphorus
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The Fuyang River belongs to the southern branch of the Ziya River system in the Haihe River Basin and originated from the Taihang Mountains. Due to the socio-economic development, industrial and agricultural production, and the large amount of water used in the city and the large-scale construction of upstream water conservancy projects, the river water has decreased, and the water environment in the river basin has continued to deteriorate. Therefore, this study takes the Fuyang River as the research object to analyze the spatiotemporal characteristics of water quality in the basin. The results show that total phosphorus presents winter> summer> autumn> winter, and dissolved total phosphorus presents winter> autumn> summer> spring.

articleTitle: Seismic Response of Rocking Double-Column Bridge Bents with External Hysteretic Dissipaters
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Rocking bent is a potential alternative for seismic resistant and post-earthquake resilience of bridges. In order to study the seismic response of rocking double-column bridge bents with external hysteretic dissipaters, this paper developed an analytical model considering the impact and dissipater fracture. The benefits of dissipaters for rocking bridge bents were validated compared with the free-rocking bent. The influence of the hysteretic dissipater parameters on the seismic response of rocking bridge bent were also analyzed. The analysis considers far-field and near-field earthquake records. The study results show that the external hysteretic dissipaters have attractive benefit on the seismic response and stability of rocking double-column bridge bents. The dissipater fracture and overturning are sensitive to the distinctive pulses of near-field records, which is crucial from the design point of view.

articleTitle: Research on the Intelligent Assessment Method of Rural Financial Risks Under Supply-Side Structural Reform
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of poor reliability of traditional financial risk assessment models, a rural financial risk assessment model is constructed under the background of supply-side structural reform. The structure of the evaluation model based on neural network is determined and the improved negative selection algorithm is used to generate the rural financial risk identification detector. The detection results of the identification detector are mapped to the nodes of the risk decision tree according to the mapping relationship, and the risk assessment model of rural finance is constructed. Compared with the traditional financial risk assessment model, it is proved that the rural financial risk assessment model under the background of supply-side structural reform is more reliable and superior.

articleTitle: Influence of Joint Reinforcement Anchorage Detailing on the Seismic Performance of Double-Column Bridge Piers
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To investigate the seismic performance of double-column bridge piers with headed reinforcement anchorage and conventional hooked bar anchorage, two reinforced concrete test models were fabricated at a scale of 1:5. Pseudostatic tests were conducted to investigate the effect of anchorage detailing on the hysteretic performance of the bridge pier models and to analyze the ductility, energy dissipation capacity, and residual displacement of the two models through comparison. By comparing two models, the following results were obtained: (1) The two models exhibit similar failure phenomena, however, the spalling and crushing of concrete under the ultimate load are more significant in the latter case than in the former case; (2) For the double-column pier with headed reinforcement anchorage, the ductility decreased slightly, whereas the bearing capacity was improved. Thus, headed reinforcement anchoring can be used in the joints of bridge piers to reduce the anchoring length and other advantages.

articleTitle: Shear Strength Study of Cohesive Sediment in The Lower Yellow River
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: It is a complex problem for the cementation strength between cohesive fine sediment. In this study, the cementation strength of cohesive fine sand is studied, and the cementation strength index is expressed by shear strength in soil mechanics. Through the shear strength test of remolded cohesive fine sediment, the shear strength parameters of cohesive fine sediment were obtained, and the effects of water content and particle size distribution on the shear strength of cohesive fine sediment were analyzed. The results show that the cohesion of cohesive fine sediment decreases with the increase of water content, the internal friction angle varies with the change of water content due to different particle size distribution, and the shear strength decreases with the change of water content. For cohesive fine sediment with median size less than 0.03mm, the shear strength with water content ranging from 5% to 30% ranges from 100 kPa to 600 kPa. For fine sediment with median size less than 0.01mm, the shear strength with water content ranging from 30% to 52% decreases significantly, mostly within 100 kPa. It can be seen that the water content has a great influence on the shear strength of cohesive fine sand. This study provides a basis for understanding the cementation strength of cohesive fine sediment grains and lays a foundation for further study on the scour resistance of cohesive fine sediment.

articleTitle: High Dimensional Massive Data Processing Based on Locality-Sensitive Hashing and Double-Layer Skiplist
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: When processing the high-dimension and massive data collected in the production process of ultra-precision machining tool, there is the issue of low efficiency in query operation of multi-key query and time range. For solving this issue, this paper propose a high-dimensional and massive data storage query method based on locality-sensitive hashing algorithm and double-layer skiplist index structure to improve the efficiency of multi-key query and time range query. In this method, by using the locality-sensitive hashing algorithm, the machine state parameters are stored in multiple similar data nodes, and the double-layer skiplist index structure is established in each data node. This method reduces the search range of multi-key query operations at the cost of a certain probability error, thereby indirectly improving query efficiency. Experimental results show that the method is effective.

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis of Passive Bevel Gear of Crusher
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The passive bevel gear cone is a very important part in the crusher equipment, but its structure is complicated and it is difficult to calculate with traditional calculation methods. In this paper, the finite element topology analysis method is used to perform reverse design calculations. The loads and external boundary conditions are directly applied to the corresponding locations using the "multi-point constraint method" without conversion and calculation. It is simple and accurate. Preliminary three-dimensional structure diagram. Then export the structural diagram and optimize it with professional 3D design software to get our design results. This reverse design can consider the safety factor and ensure the strength and rigidity of the gear are very accurate. The design method of this paper is of great significance to improve the reliability and accuracy of products, and provides theoretical and technical guidance for the structural design of similar parts.

Author Keywords: finite element reverse design topological analysis multi-point constraint

articleTitle: A Hybrid Clustering Process for Improving the Computational Efficiency of Automatic Analysis Stability Diagrams
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low efficiency of automatic analysis and calculation of stability diagram and realize real-time online identification of bridge modal parameters, an automatic analysis method of stability diagram based on hybrid clustering process is proposed. Firstly, the stability diagram of bridge structure is obtained by using Covariance-Driven stochastic subspace method; then, according to the recognition accuracy requirement, the stability diagram data are evenly divided into several frequency bands, so that the frequency similarity of the small class data and the order of distance matrix can be effectively reduced; finally, the graph theory clustering algorithm is used to automatically analyze the small class data to get the stable axis of the stability diagram. The proposed method is applied to Nanjing Yangtze River Fourth Bridge to verify the efficiency of the proposed method. The results show that the method based on hybrid clustering process can improve the computational efficiency of stability graph automatic analysis. The computational efficiency is much higher than that of pedigree clustering and graph theory clustering, and the algorithm has strong robustness.

articleTitle: Single-Image Super-Resolution Based on Morphological Component Analysis and Coupled Dictionary Learning In Wavelet Domain
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: High resolution image can provide good performance guarantee for other image processing work, so image super-resolution has always been a hot topic of research. Image super-resolution based on sparse representation and dictionary learning is a very hot technology, these method usually using first-order and second-order derivatives to extract features of image, but this extraction method can not effectively extract high-frequency features such as textures. For this problem, we propose a new single-image super-resolution algorithm that combines concepts from image decomposition theory, morphological component analysis, coupled dictionary learning and wavelet-based dictionary construction. The LR image and texture image layers are used to construct coupled dictionaries. Coupled dictionary learning is used to realize the transformation of the sparse representation coefficients of the two feature spaces through the mapping matrix. This learning scheme relaxes the constraint conditions, enhances the mapping relationship between the LR image and HR texture layers, and improves the reconstruction quality. A set of dictionaries are created in the wavelet domain, where a pair of sub-band dictionaries is designed for the structure and texture image layers in each wavelet sub-band. A total of 3 pairs of dictionaries have been constructed for the structure and texture image components. These dictionaries demonstrate the compactness, directionality, and multi-scale nature of the wavelet transform. Hence, our scheme captures image high-frequency features more effectively. Experimental comparisons show superior super-resolution results of the proposed scheme based on the peak signal-to-noise ratio and the structural similarity index.

articleTitle: Research on Photocatalytic Properties of TiO_2 Nanotube Arrays
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low time catalytic efficiency of photocatalytic hydrogen production in the field of photocatalysis, this paper proposes to improve the photocatalytic efficiency from the aspects of preparation technology of catalysts and modification by doping of other elements. First, titanium dioxide nanotube arrays were prepared by anodic oxidation. Then, by changing the process parameters, such as oxidation voltage, titanium wire diameter, water content in electrolyte and oxidation time, different morphology of titanium dioxide nanotubes were obtained. At the same time, the catalyst was doped with Fe by soaking the catalyst in iron nitrate solution, and the modification of Tio2 nanotubes was achieved, and their photocatalytic efficiency was studied. The results showed that the photocatalytic performance of the catalyst was better under the following conditions: the ratio of water to ethanol was 8:1, the diameter of the titanium filament was larger, the oxidation time was 4h, the oxidation voltage was 60V, and the iron doping concentration was 0.02mol/L. In conclusion, the above items have a significant impact on the photocatalytic efficiency. Especially, the Fe-doped catalyst showed better catalytic activity, and its hydrogen production efficiency was greatly improved when irradiated with ultraviolet light than that of the undoped catalyst.

Author Keywords: Hydrogen production from photocatalytic water splitting

articleTitle: Bridge Finite Element Model Updating Based on RBF and MODE Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the effect and efficiency of bridge finite element model updating, a bridge finite element model updating method based on radial basis function (RBF) and multi-objective differential evolution (MODE) algorithm is proposed. Firstly, in order to improve the efficiency of model updating, the high-precision RBF is used as the surrogate model to replace the original finite element model. Secondly, the MODE algorithm is used to solve the global optimization of multiple objective functions, and the reasonable solution is selected from the Pareto optimal solution set to improve the model updating effect. Finally, the numerical simply supported beam calculation is used. The results show that the error between the "measured response value" and the theoretical response value of the updated finite element model is significantly reduced, and the parameter values of the updated finite element model are close to those of the "actual bridge model", which shows that the proposed method can better realize the correction of the bridge finite element model.

articleTitle: A Low Complexity MMSE Hybrid Precoding Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of difficult design of hybrid precoding scheme for millimeter-wave massive multi-input and multi-output (Massive MIMO) systems, which is not only difficult in hardware implementation, but also with high algorithm complexity, a SIC hybrid precoding scheme based on partially connected structure is proposed. The hybrid precoding research in this paper is based on a simple fixed sub-connection structure, which converts the non-convex problem that maximizes the system reachability into the sum of the antenna sub-array rates, avoiding the problem of large-scale matrix-matrix inversion and singular value decomposition, thus greatly reducing the algorithm complexity. Through algorithm complexity analysis and system capacity performance simulation, the performance of the algorithm can be close to the optimal unconstrained algorithm, and the performance is stable and the algorithm complexity is based on 10% of sparse scattering precoding. Experimental results show that the SIC hybrid precoding algorithm not only has low algorithm complexity, but also meets the system performance requirements.

articleTitle: The Effects of BFRP Application on Seismic Capacity of Prefabricated Bridge Columns
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Prefabricated segmental bridge columns are increasingly used in bridge engineering these years. The basalt fiber reinforced polymer (BFRP) material is usually applied to wrap the vulnerable portion of bridge columns for the purpose of improving their mechanical properties. This paper investigates the effects of BFRP on the seismic capacity of prefabricated segmental columns. Finite element models of three prefabricated bridge columns, with different heights of BFRP jacket and without BFRP, were developed. The hysteresis behavior of the columns under cyclic loading was comparatively analyzed. The results show that the BFRP jacket has an increase effect on the lateral stiffness and load-carrying capacity of the segmental bridge columns under cyclic loading. The seismic capacity of prefabricated segmental column with the bottom segment wrapped with BFRP is similar to the column with two segments wrapped with BFRP.

articleTitle: Sensitivity of Seismic Response of the Steel-Concrete Plate Composite Beam Bridge with Transverse Supported Steel Beams to Design Parameters
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Effects of several design parameters on seismic response of the steel-concrete plate composite beam bridge with transverse supported steel beams, including the quantity of transverse steel beams, ratio of longitudinal steel beam and concrete plate and shear stiffness of shear stud connections, are researched. It is shown that the quantity of transverse steel beams and ratio of longitudinal steel beam and concrete plate have few effects on seismic response of the steel-concrete plate composite beam bridge with transverse supported steel beams. However, the shear stiffness of shear stud connections has significant influence on seismic response and can reduce seismic response when the shear stiffness is decreased to an extent.

Author Keywords: Steel-concrete plate composite beam bridge with transverse supported steel beam
Stiffness ratio of longitudinal steel beam and concrete plate
Shear stiffness of shear stud connection

articleTitle: Vector Operation Function Library Optimization Based on BWDSP104X
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to cooperate with the promotion of high-performance processor BWDSP1042, the cooperation of hardware and software is required, and the library function is one of the most basic and core software in high-performance computing. Its performance will directly affect the efficiency of various upper-level scientific and engineering calculations. Therefore, the implementation of library functions is closely related to the development of hardware platforms. To this end, this study designed an optimized algorithm function library with common algorithm standards based on its unique instruction characteristics and resource structure. First, based on the signal processing requirements of the basic function library, based on the Matlab function library, and The experience in signal processing selects the development functions required for each module, and based on the selected functions, the C language library is developed. Then, combined with the C language algorithm framework, the assembly language is written. The assembly language function library should be consistent with the algorithm flow of the C language function library, and the calculation error with the Matlab language library function is within a reasonable range. Finally, the running time is compared with the actual running period and the theoretical running period by using the clock cycle as a unit to check whether the operation efficiency of the assembly function meets the efficiency requirements of the library function. By making full use of bwdsp1042's computing resources in the study of this subject, the effects of reducing cycle and improving efficiency have been achieved. The relative error of the results obtained by the test function is in the order of 10-7, which is within the tolerance range. In summary, the library function development work based on the bwdsp1042 processor in this research can actively cooperate with the launch of the processor, laying a foundation for the localization of core devices.

articleTitle: Design of Motion Recognition System for Semiconductor Device Classification and Recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the widespread use of semiconductor devices and the miniaturization of device production, traditional human eye recognition in actual production workshops has been unable to meet production needs due to its low classification efficiency and low recognition rate. On the basis of the existing electromechanical technology, the functional modules such as marking and storage are integrated and installed using PLC control technology to achieve system control. The real-time operation of the classification system is controlled by the host computer software, and the entire classification is achieved according to the results of visual image processing The chip classification of the detection system improves system classification efficiency and reduces labor costs. After several performance tests on the motion control system, it was found that the system classification pass rate reached more than 96.6%, and it could run safely, stably, and efficiently. Therefore, this system can replace the original production equipment in the workshop for efficient production.

articleTitle: An Industrial Environmental Security Monitoring System in Mobile Device Based on Soft PLC
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Industrial environmental security, as one of the most fundamental and challenging problems in Soft PLC control, has received great attention in recent years. Most Soft PLC software has its own operating system, which is not easy to control for managers. This paper proposes a new industrial environmental security monitoring system based on android and discusses the whole architecture and data transition between software and hardware. At the same time, this system adopts the SVM algorithm for warning prediction to get high-accuracy. In android application, users can monitor system status anywhere. In addition, the architecture in this system is transparent for the users and devices, which means the model can be widely used in various industrial control situation.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Information Technology on Education Under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In the big data environment, information technology has penetrated into all aspects of education, and has a profound impact on education. It is of great significance to study the impact of information technology on education and improve the quality of education in the context of big data. Through the elaboration of big data and information technology, this paper analyzes the impact of information technology on education and teaching, and its positive and negative impact on curriculum design, education methods, education innovation, etc. The purpose is to give full play to the positive impact of information technology on education and teaching and avoid the negative impact of information technology on education. Using information technology to improve the quality and level of education and teaching, and promote the overall development of talents.

articleTitle: The Mechanical Behavior of Predrilled-Hole Concrete Micro-Pile in Integral Abutment Jointless Bridges (IAJBs)
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to investigate the effects of different predrilled-hole parameters on the mechanical behavior of micro-piles, Pseudo-static tests on five predrilled-hole micro-piles were carried out under unidirectional cyclic displacement load. The displacement-load curves and distribution of bending moment and displacement are analyzed. The test results indicated that the smaller the stiffness of predrilled-hole filler is, the better the deformability of specimen is. The stiffness of predrilled-hole filler has significant influence on the displacement and bending moment of pile body. Compared with the shallow predrilled-hole specimen, the deep predrilled-hole specimen has lower bearing capacity, but its deformability and bending moment are larger. The larger the diameter of predrilled-hole is, the larger the bending moment of specimen is. The larger diameter of predrilled-hole has significant effect on displacement of specimen. The deformability of predrilled-hole specimen is improved when the depth and diameter of predrilled-hole exceed 3 times of pile diameter.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Waste Battery Recycling and Intelligent Management System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The development of waste batteries is limited by their own security problems. The existing monitoring methods are limited to the local protection level of lithium battery group nodes. Generally, information cannot be transmitted to the monitoring platform for convergence and fusion to make more accurate fault diagnosis and timely fault treatment decisions. To solve these problems, this paper designs a new generation of battery integrated management system based on RFID technology of the Internet of things and ZigBee protocol. Its hardware structure adopts cc2530f2 with 6-chip as the main control chip to design ZigBee network node using wireless transceiver and task processing functions, which fully supports the latest ZigBee 2007/Pro protocol stack communication. The software design includes the establishment of multi parameter, dual RC equivalent circuit model and battery management system model, as well as Kalman filter algorithm used to estimate SOC of battery pack. Finally, the realization method and test analysis of the hardware and software of the system are described in detail, and the ideal experimental results are obtained.

articleTitle: Effect of Hydrodynamic Pressure on Seismic Response for Seismically Isolated Girder Bridge in Deep Water
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The seismic action will cause the radiation wave movement of the water body around bridge structure in deep water, which will exert hydrodynamic pressure on the underwater structure and affect the dynamic response of the bridge. In this paper, a continuous girder bridge across sea is taken as an example to study the effect of hydrodynamic pressure on seismic response for deep-water bridges with different seismic isolation systems. The seismic response analysis method of deep-water bridges under hydrodynamic pressure is firstly established, and the dynamic response analyses of the bridge with friction pendulum system and cable-sliding friction bearing system are carried out, respectively. The results show that the hydrodynamic pressure increases the seismic response of deep-water bridges. Under friction pendulum system, the influence of hydrodynamic pressure on the longitudinal internal force of each pier and pile is greater than that on the transverse internal force, and the influence on the internal force of the pile top is greater than that of the pier bottom. The influence of hydrodynamic pressure on seismic response under cable-sliding friction bearing system is obviously less than that under friction pendulum, which shows the superiority of cable-sliding friction bearing in seismic design of deep-water bridges.

articleTitle: Effects of Shear Stiffness of Stud Shear Connections in Steel-Concrete Plate Composite Beams on Seismic Response of Precast Assembly Hollow Piers
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Effects of shear stiffness of stud shear connections in steel-concrete plate composite beams on seismic response of precast assembly hollow piers is researched by use of probabilistic seismic demand analysis. The results show that seismic response of precast assembly hollow piers can be significantly reduced when shear stiffness of stud shear connections in steel-concrete plate composite beams is decreased to a certain level. The extent of seismic response reduction of precast assembly hollow piers is gradually increased with the increasing of seismic intensity. The reduction of shear stiffness of stud shear connections in steel-concrete plate composite beams is beneficial to the seismic performance of precast assembly hollow piers.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Face Recognition Technology in Public Service of Smart City
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to realize the application of face recognition technology in the public service of smart city, this paper proposes a novel application method of face recognition technology based on a variety of advanced science and technology. This method is based on a variety of information science and technology, such as Internet of things technology, Internet technology, big data technology and so on, which improves the accuracy of traditional face recognition technology. The research results show that this method can not only effectively give full play to the application of face recognition technology in all aspects of smart city public service, but also improve the modernization and intelligence of smart city public service.

articleTitle: Simulation of Linear Block Code Encoding and Decoding Based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the reliability and effectiveness of the communication system and enhance the ability of error control and error detection and correction, the paper puts forward "matching method" and "formula method", among which "matching method" is to make the coding results different from correct theoretical coding, and then realize the coding, decoding, error detection and correction quickly based on MATLAB simulation. The formula method proposes an error vector formula which is jointly determined by information bit error and supervisory bit error caused by noise interference in the channel. The experimental results show that both methods can realize the coding and error correction of linear block codes. Combined with an example, the simulation of MATLLAB was used to conduct performance analysis and comparison for many times. The simulation results showed that this method has good performance, low bit error rate, and good reliability and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on the Entrepreneurship Practice of College Huizhou Merchants Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the entrepreneurial practice ability of college students' Huizhou merchants under the environment of big data, this paper puts forward a novel research method of college students' Huizhou merchants' entrepreneurial practice based on big data. Based on big data, this method constructs big data network sharing platform, which can retrieve and mine all kinds of information related to college students' Huizhou merchants' entrepreneurship. The research results show that this method is helpful to improve the practical ability and success rate of college students' Huizhou merchants' entrepreneurship, and realize the cross-regional exchange of Huizhou merchants' entrepreneurial practical experience.

articleTitle: Fusion Modeling Method for Floating Car and Section Detection Data in Multiple Scenes
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of traffic flow data, this paper proposed a fusion method between floating car data and section detection data. Firstly, multi-scenario was discussed according to different data sources: GPS floating car system coexists with microwave radar detector, GPS floating car system coexists with ultrasonic detector, GPS floating car system coexists with travel time detector and induction Coil detectors, and only a single GPS floating car system. Second, three types of fusion models were put forward based on linear combination method, and then the model parameters were separately analyzed. Finally, the empirical experiments were verified the model validity and reliability.

articleTitle: Workspace Analysis and Design of 3-DOF Hybrid Bionic Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to design a 3-DOF hybrid bionic manipulator based on joint reintegration and bearing capacity. Firstly, the coordinate system of the 3-DOF hybrid manipulator is described, the vector method is used to solve the kinematic positive solution of the manipulator so as to express the pose of the end-effector based on the base coordinates. Second, the workspace of 3-DOF hybrid bionic manipulator is solve, and the workspace distribution map of 3-DOF hybrid bionic manipulator is obtained. The workspace analysis results shows the workspace of 3-DOF hybird bionic manipulator is fan-shaped and nearly symmetrical, structural parameters with larger workspace are obtained. Finally, a virtual prototype of the bionic manipulator is designed based on the obtained structural parameters. The manipulator has good alignment and stability, and can be used in a variety of scenarios.

Author Keywords: Bionic manipulator, 3-DOF, Hybrid mechanism, Workspace analysis, Monte Carlo method

articleTitle: Effects of Vertical Earthquake Ground Motions on Seismic Response of Steel-Concrete Plate Composite Beam Bridges
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Effects of vertical earthquake ground motion on seismic response of steel-concrete plate composite beam bridges are researched. It is shown that the influence of vertical earthquake ground motion on axial force of bridge column and pile is significantly more than shear force and bending moment. Axial force of piles can be obviously decreased when vertical earthquake ground motion is considered so that seismic performance of piles is reduced. Consequently, vertical earthquake ground motion should be selected for seismic response analysis of steel-concrete plate composite beam bridges in near-fault region.

articleTitle: Showing the Brilliance of Human Nature of Mathematics Under the Concept of Cultural Education
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Under the concept of cultural education, through the life experience of mathematical knowledge, deeply excavate the mathematical culture hidden deep in mathematical knowledge, so that mathematical knowledge shines out of the brilliance of human nature, thus sublimating people's ideological character, the psychological complex of the people, the philosophy of human life, The spiritual freedom of viewing people makes mathematics education a kind of life education of enlightenment, education, aesthetic beauty and perfection under the concept of cultural education.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Artificial Intelligence Technology in Public Product Design of Intelligent Scenic Spot
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to realize the application of artificial intelligence technology in the public product design of intelligent scenic spot, this paper puts forward a novel public product design method of intelligent scenic spot based on artificial intelligence technology. Based on artificial intelligence technology, this method can not only expand the new space of traditional tourism, but also improve tourists' satisfaction with scenic spots. The research results show that this method realizes the application of artificial intelligence technology in the public product design of intelligent scenic spots, and promotes the development of public product design of intelligent scenic spots in the direction of intelligence and modernization.

articleTitle: Research on Smartphone Marketing Method Based on Social Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to realize the application of social big data in the field of smartphone marketing, this paper puts forward a novel smartphone marketing method based on social big data. This method is based on the social big data and makes full use of big data's technology to mine and analyze the data of consumer groups in the society. The research results show that this method can effectively help smartphone enterprises to understand the needs of consumer groups, so as to facilitate smartphone enterprises to make better decision-making plans.

Author Keywords: Smartphone, Consumer Electronics Market, Marketing, big data, Social Network

articleTitle: The Performance of the North Approach Bridge of the Songyuan Bridge in Series Songyuan Earthquakes
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In recent years, earthquakes with moderate or low intensity in the Songyuan area have occurred frequently, which caused some damage in many buildings. In this paper, it is successful to assess the performance of the north approach bridge of the Songyuan Bridge in series Songyuan earthquakes by conducting both experimental and numerical studies. To measure the dynamic characteristics of the bridge and calibrate the finite-element model, ambient vibration tests were conducted. The earthquake response analysis for the bridge under the real strong ground motion records, is made. Finally, which parts may be dangerous during this earthquake are discussed.

Author Keywords: the Songyuan Bridge, the Songyuan series earthquakes

articleTitle: Application Research of BIM Technology in Architectural Structure Design
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: At present, with the rapid development of society, China's construction industry is advancing by leaps and bounds. BIM technology, as a new technology, has found a new direction for the construction industry, which is facing severe competitive pressure. This paper starts with the current situation of BIM technology, then the application of BIM technology to the building structure design of function and characteristics were analyzed, and finally explore the application of BIM technology in building structure design, and from the building structure parameter design, the structure of the building structure modeling, building space design in explore the specific application of BIM technology, provide reference for the practical application of BIM technology. It is hoped that BIM technology can be improved so as to create more effective economic benefits for the society in building structure design and meet the relevant requirements of building structure design.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Local Scour Around Caissons with Different Shapes Under the Unidirectional and Tidal Currents
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Despite more and more attention has been paid to the study of local scour under the action of tidal current, seldom research on the effect of tidal current on the scour process around different shapes of caissons has been carried out so far. In order to investigate the time development of local scour around different shapes of caisson under the unidirectional or tidal current, a series of laboratory tests was conducted in a flume laboratory. Three shapes of caisson (circular, square and diamond) and two types of currents (unidirectional and tidal) were used to study the characteristics and time evolution of local scour. The main findings include: (1) the time evolution of scour depth under tidal current is slower and easier to be stable than that of unidirectional current; (2) the appropriate shape of water-facing surface on the caisson has the function of active scour measurement, which can influence the maximum scour depth around caissons with different shapes; (3) except for diamond caisson, the locations of the maximum scour depth around circular and square caisson will change under unidirectional current or tidal current; (4) square caisson is more sensitive to the effect of tidal current, diamond caisson is less sensitive.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Big Data in the Field of Strategic Management of Cultural Industry
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to realize the application of big data in the field of strategic management of cultural industry, this paper puts forward a novel strategic management method of cultural industry based on big data technology. This method is based on big data technology and can mine and analyze all kinds of data produced by the cultural industry. The research results show that this method can effectively promote the prosperity and development of China's cultural industry, and contribute to the improvement of China's cultural industry system.

articleTitle: Study on Design of Port Truck Reservation Information System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: When trucks enter the port and operate inside the port, they often face severe traffic congestion. At present, trucks of many port companies in China are randomly arriving, resulting in low operational efficiency, high error rates, and a large waste of time and cost, especially in the vicinity of ports. According to the actual needs of the port, this paper uses the B/S mode to design the port truck reservation system, which combines the driver reservation data in the reservation system with the data of the port production service system, and automatically matches the gate of the port with the truck and the reservation information of it through the RFID technology, and appoints a unique picking stack for the truck. This system is of great significance to the construction of intelligent ports and the actual work of the port.

articleTitle: Distortion Signal Sensing Technology of Wireless Optical Fiber Communication Network Based on Greedy Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low perceptual accuracy in the existing communication distortion signal sensing methods, a wireless fiber communication network distortion signal sensing technology based on greedy algorithm is proposed. The distortion signal acquisition system of wireless optical fiber communication network is constructed, and the distortion signal cyclic spectrum is detected based on the indirect learning block diagram to realize the distortion signal feature acquisition. Combining with the matching degree algorithm, the characteristic matching processing of the distorted signal is carried out, the region detection architecture of the distorted signal is designed, and the sensing process of the distorted signal in the wireless fiber communication network is constructed based on the greedy algorithm. The simulation results show that the designed distortion signal sensing technology is more accurate than the traditional method and more practical.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Mechanical Performance of the Corbel of Pile-Plate Structure
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The corbel of pile-slab structure is a key link in the research system of pile-slab structure. However, there are few studies on stilts of pile-slab structure. For the pile-and-plate structure, due to the high degree of innovation in the overall design concept, a reasonably feasible corbel structure is required. Therefore, this paper analyzes and calculates the mechanical performance of the corbels of the Hefei-Wuhu pile-slab structure in order to obtain reasonable mechanical parameters and improvement schemes.

articleTitle: Study on Temperature Stress and Temperature Deformation of Rectangular Hollow Thin Wall High Pier of High-Speed Railway Bridge
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The temperature stress and the pier top temperature deformation of high-speed railway rectangular hollow thin-walled high pier, caused by the Sunshine temperature difference and cold wave cooling effect are not good for the stability and safety of the bridge structure. In serious cases, it will cause engineering accidents. In order to study the distribution of temperature stress and temperature deformation, established a solid finite element analysis model, and the distribution and characteristics of the stress and deformation of pier under the influence of sunshine temperature difference and cold wave cooling are analyzed. The results show that under the longitudinal and transverse sunshine temperature, the concrete of the pier is mainly subjected to compression, and the maximum stress generally appears at the corners. Increasing the arc chamfer can effectively reduce the stress concentration phenomenon, the displacement of the pier top caused by the longitudinal sunshine temperature is small, and caused by the transverse sunshine temperature is large. under the load of cold wave, the outer wall of the pier is tensile stress and the inner is compressive stress, the maximum tensile stress at the outer wall exceeding the allowable tensile stress, in order to prevent concrete cracking, it is recommended to arrange sufficient horizontal and vertical steel bars on the outside. The pier top horizontal displacement caused by the cold wave is small can negligible, the research results can provide reference for the reliable design and safe construction of similar piers in the future.

articleTitle: Seismic Performance Evaluation of FRP-Reinforced Beam Bridges Based on Vulnerability
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: FRP is widely used due to its good performance in seismic reinforcement of structures. The reinforcement effect was evaluated by analyzing the vulnerability of the bridge before and after FRP reinforcement. At present, most of the rigorous analysis of bridge FRP seismic reinforcement is carried out, and the vulnerability analysis of FRP after seismic reinforcement is relatively rare. Taking a 4-span continuous beam bridge as an example, OpenSees is used to establish a finite element model of the reinforced bridge and the unreinforced bridge. The Pushover method and the IDA method were used to analyze the seismic capacity and seismic demand of the structure to obtain the seismic vulnerability curve before and after reinforcement.

articleTitle: Seismic Mitigation and Isolation Control of High-Speed Railway Extradosed Cable-Stayed Bridge Under Multi-point Ground Motion
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The influence of multi-point earthquake excitation on seismic mitigation and isolation control of high-speed railway extradosed cable-stayed bridge is studied. Taking the main bridge of yingshang super large bridge in Shangqiu-hefei-Hangzhou high speed railway as an example, finite element calculation model is established, and nonlinear dynamic time history analysis method is used. the calculation results of internal forces and displacements of the bridge are obtained when the seismic wave velocity is 250m/s, 500m/s, 750m/s, 1500m/s, 2500m/s and infinite (equivalent to uniform excitation) by using common bearing, viscous damper, lock-up devices and hyperboloid spherical seismic isolation bearings, respectively. The results show that: (1) The seismic response of the bridge is different under the action of different seismic wave velocity, when the wave velocity is 750 m/s, the internal force and displacement of the structure reach the peak value; (2) When the traveling wave effect is considered, the internal forces and displacements of the piers with three types of seismic isolation devices and common bearings have an increasing tendency; (3) the viscous damper and the hyperboloid spherical seismic isolation bearings have better seismic performance, while the lock-up devices increase the overall stiffness of the bridge, and thus amplify the internal force response of the structure.

articleTitle: Optimization Model for Calculating Capacity of Urban Road Segments
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to overcome the shortage of the typical factors considered in the traffic capacity calculation model, the traffic management factors that affect urban road traffic capacity are analyzed, the calculation model of segment capacity considering traffic management factors is set up, the calculation model of reduction factor of the pedestrian management factors among traffic management factors is also set up. Finally, according to the survey data of zhuhai road segments, the traffic management factors that affect urban road traffic capacity are analyzed, and the calculation model is verified through the traffic simulation technology . The results show that the calculation results of the capacity of the model are consistent with the simulation results, and the calculation model of segment capacity considering traffic management factors is reasonable.

articleTitle: An Automatic Page Code Generation Method Based on Excel Template and Poi Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In the current research or development process of information management systems, related system interfaces often have the characteristics of complex business operation, high repetitiveness and profession. This will make it difficult for software developers to accurately handle the content and format of the page interfaces, and thus reduce development efficiency. To address this problem, this paper introduces Excel document which the commonly used in enterprise management as code generation template, and constructs a method for automatically generating web interface code based on Java POI technology. In practical applications, it is shown that this method can realize the rapid and automatic generation of key interfaces in the information management system, and effectively utilize Excel documents in existing transactions to achieve efficient management knowledge reuse and code reuse, improve development efficiency and reduce research and development costs.

articleTitle: Research on the Supervision Method of Big Data Technology in the Systemic Risk of Internet Finance in China
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to standardize the supervision process of systemic risk of Internet finance in China, this paper puts forward a novel supervision method of systemic risk of Internet finance in China based on big data technology. This method is based on big data technology, combines computer technology and Internet of things technology, can real-time monitor the systematic data of China's Internet finance, and quickly feedback the information to the relevant staff. The results show that this method can effectively improve the standardization of China's Internet financial systemic risk supervision and reduce the harm caused by China's Internet financial systemic risk.

articleTitle: Theoretical and Experimental Study on Load-Carrying Capacity Evaluation of CFRP Plates Bond-Type Anchors
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to reveal the anchorage mechanism of CFRP plate anchorage, a theoretical model of the bearing capacity and critical anchorage length of CFRP plate anchorage is established. The relationship between shear stress and compressive stress of anchorage interface is obtained by experiments. The model considers the longitudinal reduction of the interface shear stress in the anchorage zone, and the longitudinal reduction coefficient of the interface shear stress is measured by experiments. The influence of parameters of plate anchorage on anchorage performance is analyzed by using the above model. The results show that the longer the anchorage length is, the larger the reduction rate of interfacial shear stress is. The design bearing capacity and critical anchorage length of anchorage increase linearly with the increase of CFRP plate size. With the increase of interfacial compressive stress, the interfacial shear stress increases and the critical anchorage length decreases. When the interfacial compressive stress is less than 100 MPa, the size of the interfacial shear stress is linear with the interfacial shear stress. For the commonly used engineering CFRP plate with the size of 100mm*2.0mm, when the interface pressure stress is 100MPa and the design value of the tensile strength of CFRP plate is 2400MPa, the required critical anchorage length is 279mm, and the corresponding anchorage design bearing capacity is 720kN, which can make the tensile strength of CFRP plate fully play in theory.

articleTitle: Research on the Overturning Stability of the Straight Ramp Bridge Under the Conditions of Accident Vehicle Rescue
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: When heavy vehicle accident occurs on the ramp bridge, the rescue condition of the crane may lead to the overturning disaster of the ramp bridge. For the straight ramp bridge, three typical load conditions for heavy vehicle to be rescued by cranes are proposed. The calculation method of overturning stability is proposed, which includes three items of bridge bearing disengaging, anti-overturning stability and local bearing capacity of the bridge deck. The computational results show that: (1) the risk of bearing disengaging when the crane running close to the accident vehicle is greater than that when the crane lifting the accident vehicle; (2) the crane should be driven in the vicinity of the center line to reduce the risk of bearing disengaging; (3) the anti-overturning stability coefficients of the ramp bridge while the crane rescuing the typical heavy vehicles in this paper meet the requirements of the Chinese bridge codes.

articleTitle: Applicability of Artificial Waves to Seismic Vulnerability of High-Speed Railway Continuous Bridge
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Artificial seismic waves can be easily generated by software, and needs identification if they can be used to evaluate the seismic vulnerability of general bridges. A finite element model of a (48+80+48)m continuous girder bridge in a high-speed railway was built by OpenSEES software, and was calculated by an incremental dynamic analysis (IDA) using both the artificial waves and actual waves. The seismic fragility curves for major structural components under the artificial waves and actual waves were developed assuming lognormal distributions for both the demand and capacity of bridge structure, and then compared with each other. The comparison results show that there is a perfect consistency between the seismic responses under both the artificial waves and actual waves for most components. Although the seismic responses of sliding layer under the actual waves are slightly different from those under the artificial waves, the largest error of damage exceeding probability between them is still acceptable. Therefore, the artificial waves can be used to evaluate the seismic vulnerability for the continuous girder bridges in a high-speed railway under earthquakes.

articleTitle: Aero Engine Condition Evaluation Based on D-S Evidence Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Due to the multi-parameter, uncertainty and conflict of aero engine condition monitoring data, it is difficult to establish an accurate mechanism model to describe the aero engine health state changes. This paper takes aero engine as a specific object, proposing a health condition evaluation model based on D-S evidence theory. The model selects key monitoring parameters and historical data, and uses multi-source information fusion to synthesize multiple evidences to obtain the aero engine health status results. Research on the assessment of the health status of aero engines is helpful for timely detection of their potential failures and health deterioration trends, further to achieve maintenance based on the health status of aero engines. At last, the feasibility and reliability of the model was verified by combining with an actual example.

articleTitle: Influence of Far-Field Ground Motion on Seismic Response of Rocking Isolated Bridge Piers
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To explore the influence of far-field long-period ground motion on the seismic response of free-rocking isolated bridge piers, the finite element model is established with the platform of OpenSees. Three far-field long-period ground motions and three common ground motion records are input respectively. Test data such as pier top displacement, pier bottom rotation angle, bending moment of the bottom of the pier are obtained. The results show that the pier top displacement and the bottom rotation angle of the free-rocking isolated pier under far-field long-period ground motion are much larger than those of the common ground motion, while the bending moment of the bottom of the pier is not much different from the common ground motion. And combined with the existing shaking table test data, the simulated data like the pier top displacement and the bottom bending moment under the far-field long-period ground motion and common ground motion are basically consistent with the test.

articleTitle: Study on Calculation of Construction Cable Force of Cable-Stayed Bridge Based on Unstressed State Method
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the tension of the cable tension caused by the large change in the construction state during the construction of the cable-stayed bridge does not meet the safety requirements, the calculation needs to be readjusted. Based on the basic principle of the unstressed state method, a calculation method for the adjustment of the construction cable force under a change in the state of the construction state of the structure is proposed. The calculation example of a bridge under construction demonstrates the correctness of the method. The advantage of the main cable force calculation method when coping with large changes in construction status. The research results show that the method can quickly adjust the construction cable force when the amount of construction state changes greatly, thereby ensuring the realization of a reasonable bridge goal.

articleTitle: Effects of Fluid-Structure Interaction on Nonlinear Seismic Response of Deep-Water Hollow Bridge Pier
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper uses numerical method to investigate the characteristics of nonlinear seismic responses of a typical deep-water hollow bridge pier. With the bilinear moment-curvature beam elements and 3D solid elements modeling the hollow pier and potential-based fluid elements modeling the water domain, three dimensional finite element models for the typical deep-water bridge pier are built, and the numerical model is verified to be reliable. Through nonlinear time history analyses, seismic responses of the deep-water bridge pier under different water levels are studied for two cases where the hollow piers contact with outer water only and both outer and inner water. The numerical results indicates that seismic responses of the deep water hollow pier increase generally with water level, especially the shear force response of the pier bottom which is obviously enlarged by fluid-structure interaction since a low water level. For bridge piers submerged in deep water, the bending moment of the pier bottom is greater than that of dry bridge piers, which makes it easier for the pier bottom to yield. When the yielding happens, the curvature ductility demand of the bottom section is significantly amplified, and the damage index of the bridge pier is distinctly expanded. The existence of the inner water would cause further demand of the curvature ductility which may lead to aggravated damages to the deep-water piers. These findings can provide valuable guidance for future deep-water bridge design.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on Patent Eligibility of Artificial Intelligence in the United States, China and Japan
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: To enhance the possibility of patent entitled of artificial intelligence-related inventions, firstly, patent applicants should concentrate on their construction of the claims to indicate what technical problems the invention are solving or identify the specific improvements made by the claims; secondly, the claims should be narrowly focused and provide technical solutions to technical problems, and each of the technical problems and technical solutions should be described in specification. In order to stimulate the innovation of artificial intelligence-related technologies, many countries have revised the patent examination guidelines in recent years. Patent offices in the United States, China, and Japan are the most important patent offices for artificial patent applications in the world. Japan has the loosest provision on the object. Both China and Japan have authorizations for pure algorithm patents. The United States has the strictest on the object of patent eligibility before 2019, but the newly revised guide has significantly relaxed the scope of the object.

articleTitle: Justification of the Economic Efficiency of a Rational Method to Increase the Snow Accumulation at the Fields
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: It is shown, that the main factor determining the success of the cultivation of crops in the republic is their moisture supply during the growing season. To solve the problem of plant moisture supply, it is recommended to carry out snow retention, which contributes to the retention and accumulation of snow in the fields, ploughed field and agricultural holdings, to protect plants from freezing, and to increase moisture reserves in the soil. In this paper, we analyze two ways to increase snow accumulation in the agricultural lands in the Republic of Kazakhstan: the formation of stubble coulisses during harvesting and the double mechanical snow retention at the stubble background. To perform the first option, Yenisei KZS-950 harvester thresher is used together with a reaping machine of the direct combining with a stripper adapter installed in its center. To perform the second option, it is necessary to use Yenisei KZS-950 harvester thresher together with the ZhZK-7.1 reaping machine of the direct combining for harvesting, as well as K-744R1 tractor together with SVSh-10 snow breaker for the double mechanical snow retention. The economic evaluation of experimental results shows that the use of the reaping machine of direct combining with the stripper adapter will ensure annual savings of total cash costs in the amount of 3182.6 tenge/ha. The economic effect was obtained by reducing the total cash costs in particular due to the formation of stubble coulisses during the harvesting process as a result of which additional funds are not required for the mechanical snow retention.

articleTitle: Optimization Model for Coupled Wind and Thermal Power Transmission of Large-Scale Wind Power Transmission Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the large-scale wind power transmission end grid wind and thermal power shared transmission channel decoupling out, the wind power output power is blocked, the transmission channel utilization rate is not high and so on. Based on a comparative analysis of wind and fire electrolytic coupling / coupling transmission operation characteristics, this paper The goal is to maximize the output power of wind power, maximize the utilization of transmission channels, and minimize the operating costs of thermal power units. Aiming at the dispatching output of wind power and thermal power units as optimization variables, a multi-objective optimization model of coupled wind power and thermal power transmission is proposed. The target differential evolution algorithm solves the model, and finally obtains a set of optimized scheduling output plans for wind and thermal power, which provides a scientific basis for operators to make scheduling decisions. Finally, a regional power grid is taken as an example to prove the rationality of the model and the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

Author Keywords: Wind and fire electrolytic coupling / coupling delivery

articleTitle: Study on Construction Technology of Prestressed Cross Polygon Assembled Fiber Concrete Tower Crane Foundation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In this paper, a prestressed cross polygon assembled tower crane foundation is proposed. Because the foundation is designed as a multi-purpose combination, it can be applied to different forms of tower foundation. The utilization rate of the foundation is as high as 100%. The construction method of prestressed cross polygon assembled tower crane foundation meets the requirements of traditional tower crane foundation for safety and practicability. The prestressed tower crane foundation is a kind of tower crane which can be removed without fixed foundation. It can be used repeatedly with low amortization cost, which reduces the lease cost and has certain engineering application value.

articleTitle: Design of On-Line Detection and Training Device for Certain Wireless Communication Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that a certain type of wireless communication equipment is difficult to achieve online detection and a single maintenance and training means, a method of adapting computer control to the whole machine and circuit board is proposed and implemented. Online detection of various states and main performance indicators of the whole type of communication equipment and circuit board, and provides a teaching mode for maintenance training. It is convenient for maintenance personnel to quickly and effectively detect this type of communication equipment, and to form its maintenance support capability.

articleTitle: Structural Analysis of Precast Concrete Segments of Bheri Babai Diversion Multipurpose Project
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: By establishing the finite element model of precast concrete segments of Bheri Babai Diversion Multipurpose Project in ANSYS, a structural analysis of precast concrete segments is done, considering construction stage-assembling of segmental ring, segments from production to transport and operating stage, finally getting the necessary reinforcement for segments of the tunnel.

articleTitle: Research on Structural Damage Identification by Use of No Inversion Algorithm of Frequency
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The frequency research methods for structural damage identification could be divided into two categories, whether inversion or not. The feasibility was confirmed on structural damage diagnosis by natural frequency vector and characteristic value curve. Take the simply supported beam as an example, using the two methods for identification and the two results were compared. The damage location could be accurately identified by the natural frequency vector method with large calculation; Damage signatures database construction by use of natural frequency vector method was a huge project, like a bridge with distribution parameters and more degrees of freedom. So How to use natural frequency vector method to get optimum recognition results was still a serious problem. However, the method by characteristic value curve had the advantages, such as identifying the damage location accurately with less calculation but also had Cannot accurately identify damage degree.

articleTitle: A Smart Graduation Thesis Templates Parsing and Generation Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of complicated formats in graduation thesis writing, a smart graduation thesis format parsing and generation model is proposed. First, a model is built based on the features of the thesis templates analyzed and extracted. Then templates are generated automatically according to user preferences. Finally, content of the thesis is incorporated into the specified template. Experiment shows that it can automatically generate format information according to the templates without human intervention, which could save a lot of time and reduce format errors.
