articleTitle: Parametric Analysis of Transverse Load Distribution of the Spine-Like Beam with Long Cantilever
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Spine-like beam with long cantilever has been used in the application in urban bridges for its grace outline and economical efficiency. Due to the large size of the cantilever, the spatial effect should be considered during design and analysis, and the load distribution related to decks and ribs cannot be ignored. Based on the Kongcheng River bridge, the author analyzed the deformation and internal force of a series of 3D finite element models with different rib spacings and deck thicknesses. Using internal force and deflection distribution coefficients to portray the load distribution, the influence of different parameters on the coefficient was studied. Meanwhile, two regression models were proposed to estimate the load distribution status with different rib spacing or deck thickness. The internal force and deflection coefficient fitted curves have enough precision for engineering practice, hence it could provide a reference for similar practical engineering.

articleTitle: Research on Enterprise Human Resource Management Under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the development of information technology, the emergence of big data technologies and supporting solutions is helping companies to digitally transform. At the same time, corporate human resources management has also shifted from traditional problem-driven to data-driven in the era of big data, helping managers make more prudent and scientific human resource management decisions from a more dimensional perspective. Enterprise human resource management should actively use big data, keep up with the pace of the big data era, carry out a comprehensive innovation of itself, inject fresh blood into human resource work, and promote the further development of enterprise human resource management. Making full use of the advantages of data information and network platforms for human resource management. I believe that with the help of big data analysis, human resource management will become better and better for enterprises.

articleTitle: Research and Realization of Real Estate Sales System Based on VR Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that consumers cannot have a comprehensive understanding of the community in the process of traditional real estate sales, this paper puts forward a method to restore the scene by using VR technology, according to CAD drawings, effect drawings, control rules and other methods. Virtual reality technology has three characteristics: Immersion, Interaction and Imagination .With its 3I properties, virtual reality can create an immersive virtual environment. In this way, consumers only need a few minutes to know the whole situation of the current real estate, making the whole process of consumption become relaxed, happy. It promotes the sale of real estate, reduces the marketing cost and avoids the hesitation of consumers and disputes between the two sides in the later stage.

articleTitle: Design of Automatic Testing System for Electrical Equipment Based on PCI Bus
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In view of the fact that the traditional safety detection system has incorrect detection of errors of electromechanical devices, an automatic detection system design of electrical equipment based on PCI bus is proposed. Through the optimization of system hardware configuration, the operation performance of the automatic detection system is improved, the software flow of the automatic detection system of electrical equipment is further improved, the structure and operation steps of the sensing module are simplified, and the collection and accurate display of safety data are ensured. Furthermore, the abnormal information and error information collected in the automatic detection process of electrical equipment are collected and fault-tolerant analyzed by using calculation and C language framework, and corrected and improved according to the analysis results, so as to finally realize the effective design of the automatic detection system of electrical equipment.

articleTitle: Research On Tag Recommendation Based on Multiple Keywords
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The user inquiry system is a tool that we often use in our daily life. The effect of a inquiry system directly affects the user's experience. But the user will enter multiple keywords in the query to express what they really want to search, but this is usually a lot of noise caused by the impact of individual keywords, so this paper proposes a keyword query intention of mixed probability model, the model can be recommended result of query words together with the query intention fusion, and thus to minimize noise on the result of recommended keywords. This article also add tags to key words, as the query keywords supplement,. This method can not only make up for the noise interference of multiple keywords, but also calculate the similarity between the tag and the tag that has been marked on the web page, so as to judge the relevance between the user's query intention and the web page content more accurately. Finally, the results that are more in line with the user's query interest are ranked in the front position. Experimental results show that the proposed method is more effective.

articleTitle: Seismic Performance of Precast Segmental Bridge Columns on the Basis of Bouc-Wen Hysteresis Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to study the seismic performance and hysteresis behavior of precast segmental columns, the Bouc-Wen hysteresis model was improved, considering the strength degradation, stiffness degradation and pinching effect of precast segmental columns. By reasonably selecting the parameters, hysteretic curves of different shapes were obtained to simulate the nonlinear hysteresis characteristics of the piers in actual engineering. Three circular section columns with a scale ratio of 1:3.5 were tested under quasi-static cyclic loading to determine the control parameters that affect the hysteresis characteristics of the model, which are monolithic reinforced concrete columns (MRC), unbonded prestressed precast segmental columns (PSC) and unbonded prestressed precast segmental columns with energy dissipation bars (PSCE). Finally, the Simulink module in Matlab was used to solve the differential equations, and the three tested specimens were simulated respectively. The predicted results were in good agreement with the force-displacement hysteretic curves obtained by the quasi-static test, which proves the improved hysteresis model proposed in this paper can accurately predict the nonlinear hysteretic response of precast segmental columns under cyclic loading protocols.

articleTitle: Research on Target Recognition Method Based on Integrated Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of obstacle recognition in front of vehicles, a method of obstacle recognition based on heterogeneous integrated learning is proposed. The heterogeneous data includes video image and radar text data. The purpose of heterogeneous integration is to increase the attention of vulnerable groups. In this method, alexnet, vggnet-16 and text CNN are used to train models on large-scale datasets, and the migration learning method is used to migrate to the traffic obstacle datasets to train different classification models. Finally, the weighted voting method is used to build the integration model. The experimental results show that the accuracy of this method is 99.10% compared with the single recognition method, and it has a better recognition effect.

articleTitle: Research on Combination of Seismic and Temperature Action Effects of Multi-span Long Continuous Girder
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to reduce the seismic response of the multi-span long continuous girder under strong ground motions, the system mostly use seismic isolation bearings. Under the action of annual temperature difference, the bearings will produce an initial displacement, which changes the initial balance position of the structure and increases the demand of bearing displacement. The combination of seismic and temperature action belongs to the superposition of multiple random processes, and the code does not give a clear combination coefficient. Based on Turkstra combination method, this paper calculates the combination coefficient of temperature action in the seismic design. Through finite element analysis, it compares the response of the isolation system with friction pendulum support and cable-sliding friction aseismic bearing under the combination of seismic and temperature action.

articleTitle: Analysis of Wind Field Parameters of Bridge Location Based on Wind Field Measurement
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Based on the long-term near-surface boundary layer wind field measurement, this paper analyzes the wind field characteristics of the southeast coastal areas of Fujian. Based on the measured wind field data, the characteristics of average wind speed profile of the monsoon is studied systematically. At the same time, the mathematical characteristics of the turbulence parameters of the wind-resistant design in the structural wind engineering are statistically quantified, including: turbulence intensity, turbulent integral scale, gust coefficient and fluctuating wind speed power spectrum are compared with the existing bridge design specifications. The results can provide reference for the selection of wind filed parameters for bridge design in southeast coastal areas of Fujian province.

articleTitle: Study on Fatigue Resistance Parameters Design of Orthotropic Steel Bridge Deck Based on Response Surface Method
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The structure of orthotropic steel bridge deck is complex, and the fatigue problem is easy to occur under the cyclic action of traffic loads. In order to optimize the fatigue resistance performance, taking the main girder of a cable stayed bridge, the response surface method is used to establish the approximate response surface model of stress amplitude of multi-position and the self-weight response surface model. According to response surface models, the multi-objective optimization problem is transformed into a single-objective optimization problem by weight method, and the optimal solutions of parameters under different weights are found. The results show that the response surface model simulated by the response surface method has a high degree of fitting with the results of the finite element method. It can be used as the basis for parameter optimization. The optimal solution for the parameters at the weight method can meet the purpose of reducing the self-weight and the internal stress of the structure well.

articleTitle: Research of Genomic Problems Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of the poor convergence performance of particle swarm optimization algorithm and falling into local optimum in complex optimization problems, a design method of the intelligent fusion algorithm combined with branch and bound algorithm to solve genomic problems is proposed. Particle swarm optimization and artificial bee colony algorithm as high-efficiency heuristic algorithms have high application value in solving combinatorial optimization problems. By effectively combining the two algorithms, they can make use of their respective advantages to make up for their respective shortcomings. At the same time, the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm is introduced into the branch and bound method, which can make up for the limitations of the branch and bound method, reduce the useless search of the algorithm, and improve the efficiency of the algorithm. The experimental results show that the proposed method improves the efficiency of solving genome problems, which lays a foundation for the further application of genome problems in practice.

articleTitle: Optimal Placement of Sensors Based on Clustering-Effective Independent Method
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The effective independent method is the most widely used method in optimization algorithm. It can reflect the structural characteristics and obtain the modal information, but it cannot effectively obtain the damage information, and it also has the problems of low response and concentration of measuring points. In this paper, the clustering algorithm and strain mode are introduced to modify it, and the information matrix containing both structural damage information and modal information is established by using the vibration displacement response and strain response equation of the system. This method is applied to the Dashengguan Yangtze River Bridge in Nanjing, and a comprehensive evaluation system is established to evaluate the effectiveness of the optimization method. The results show that this method has good effect on the independence of modal information, response of measuring point and damage sensitivity of measuring point.

articleTitle: Analysis on Anti-Jamming Performance Test Method of Communication System in New Energy Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The anti-interference performance test method of the communication system of the traditional new energy power plant has the shortcoming of long test time. To this end, the anti-interference performance test method of the communication system of the new energy power plant is proposed. By determining the interference type of the new energy communication system, establishing the anti-interference performance index of the communication system, and then calculating the differential mode rejection ratio, common mode rejection ratio and bit error rate, the anti-interference performance test method analysis of the communication system of the new energy power plant is completed. Compare the test time with two traditional anti-interference performance test methods, the experimental results show that the proposed anti-jamming performance test method of communication system in new energy power plant requires shorter test time, and the results indicating that it has a higher test efficiency.

articleTitle: Innovative Research on the Training Mode of Accounting Professionals Under the Environment of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to make the training mode of accounting professionals more in line with the environment of big data, this paper puts forward an effective and innovative scheme. The scheme uses scientific and efficient big data technology to build big data information platform, which can provide modern and intelligent technical support for the efficient accounting professional training mode. At the same time, by using the methods of literature analysis and comparative study, this paper further discusses the close relationship between the emergence of big data era and the reform of accounting professionals. The research result of this paper is to realize the reform and innovation of the training mode of accounting professionals in colleges and universities based on big data platform, and then solve the main disadvantages of the traditional training mode of accounting professionals in our country, for example, unclear teaching objectives, unscientific curriculum and so on.

articleTitle: Application of Quasi -Dimensional Turbulent Combustion Model in Combustion Cycle Analysis of Gasoline Engine
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to accurately calculate and predict the change of turbulence parameters in gasoline engine cylinder combustion cyclic variability, a quasi-dimensional turbulent combustion model is established and a parameter λ/6µ_1 of cyclic variation at the initial stage of quantitative combustion is modified in this paper. Finally, the quasi-dimensional turbulent combustion model and the modified parameter λ/6µ_1 are used to analyze and predict the effect of turbulence on combustion cyclic variability. Experimental results show that the quasi-dimensional turbulent combustion model can predict the initial small scale turbulence effect of combustion cyclic variability. The comparison of experimental standard deviation and predictive standard deviation can be used as a powerful tool to identify and analyze the importance of different factors combustion cyclic variability. It can provide a reference for the experimental study of this problem and lay a foundation for the establishment of combustion cyclic variability model in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Types and Data Characteristics of Freeway Escape in Henan Province
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: This paper summarizes the characteristics of typical toll evasion behaviors by investigating the types of toll evasion on highways in Henan Province. Using big data analysis and mining methods to study vehicle characteristics and related relationships, the paper makes a mining analysis on Henan Province's toll data for three days in mid-2018, studies the relationship between vehicles, weight, driving time, and whether vehicles have a fee evasion behavior. It establishes a strategy for identifying toll evasion behaviors and a prediction model for the behaviors, provides technical support to establish an anti-fare-evasion inspection system for highways, realizes intelligent prediction and classification of fare evasion behaviors, and assists the manual inspection of fare evasion customers, and improves the inspectors' efficiency, achieves efficient and accurate prediction of fare evasion and then fight against fare evasion.

articleTitle: Short Term Prediction Method of Financial Crisis Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: When a large number of enterprises fall into financial crisis at the same time, they will probably trigger a new financial crisis. Therefore, how to effectively predict the financial crisis of enterprises has become an urgent concern. However, the existing financial crisis early warning research mainly focuses on the traditional single classifier financial crisis prediction method, which is lack of systematic researches. Not only the financial crisis prediction method of artificial intelligence single classifier needs to be further expanded, but also ignores the benefits that may be brought about by the combination of multiple classifiers for financial crisis prediction. The important role of expert experience knowledge and non-financial information on the financial crisis early warning is discussed. Under the background of this research, the current rapid development of computer science, artificial intelligence, data mining and group decision-making theory provides a way of thinking for the research of the financial crisis early warning from a new perspective.

articleTitle: Research on Seismic Simplified Analysis Method Under Rare Earthquake Continuous Rigid Frame Bridge with Qualified CFST Stack
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Based on the Labajin Bridge, this paper uses Midas civil finite element software to establish a calculation model for the high-dose continuous rigid frame bridge with qualified CFST stack. Taking the height of the pier, the slope of the laced pier and the steel content of the column and limb as the design parameters, the calculation model of 40 different periods is constructed, and the high-dose continuous rigid frame bridge with qualified concrete-filled steel tube stacks under the rare earthquake The elastic and elastoplastic time-history analysis is carried out. By comparing the displacement and bending moment time-history curves of the control section, it is found that the vibration modes of the two different analysis methods are more consistent. Based on this, the seismic simplification method of the bridge is studied. Using the statistical induction method, the relationship between the control section displacement, the bending moment adjustment coefficient and the structural period is obtained by fitting, and the equivalent elastic method is proposed. The algorithm is verified by different seismic waves, fortification intensity and acceleration peak. The results show that the proposed equivalent elastic method agrees well with the elastoplastic method. The research results can effectively improve the computational efficiency of seismic design, and also provide reference and reference for the seismic design specifications of such structural systems.

articleTitle: Study on Weak Signal Perception of Optical Communication Network System Based on Double Sparse Dictionary Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The traditional weak signal sensing method for optical communication network system has the problem of large sensing error. Therefore, a weak signal sensing method for optical communication network system based on double sparse dictionary model is proposed. The general frame of weak signal sensing method for optical communication network system based on double sparse dictionary model is built. According to the overall framework, a double-sparse dictionary model is established to train the sample weak signals and realize the sparse coding and dictionary update of the weak signals. Orthogonal matching tracking algorithm is used to realize sparse reconstruction of weak signals and accurate perception of weak signals in optical communication networks. Compared with the traditional method, the experimental results show that the proposed method has less error, can more accurately perceive the weak signal of optical communication network system, and has strong practicability.

articleTitle: Seismic Response Analysis of the Rocking Double-Deck Bridge
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Double deck viaducts relied on ductility design are vulnerable to earthquake-induced damage. To controlling the seismic damage, a new double deck bridge with the low piers designed as the rocking structure is proposed. The seismic analysis model of the structure is derived by using the Lagrange method and momentum conservation law. The seismic behavior is studied by comparing with monolithic reinforced concrete double deck bridge. The result shows that the rocking of the lower floor structure can significantly reduce the deformation of upper structure as well as avoid plastic damage.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis and Simulation of Photovoltaic Array Based on M File
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the rapid development of photovoltaic industry, the service life and safety of photovoltaic array have attracted more and more attention. If the photovoltaic array under fault is not diagnosed and treated in time, it may cause fire and other serious consequences. Therefore, study of simulation and fault diagnosis of p-v arrays, has very important significance. In this paper, according to the output characteristics of photovoltaic array in different environments and fault conditions, M file was written to simulate the photovoltaic array under complex light conditions, short circuit fault conditions and shadow occlusion conditions. By studying p-v curve of the photovoltaic array, the output characteristics of the photovoltaic array in different environments and fault conditions are analyzed, and fault diagnosis is made.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Scenic Area Guide System Based on Visual Communication
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Based on the background of intelligent tourism environment at home and abroad, this paper defines the key technologies and development tools involved in the system, introduces the operation process in detail, builds the system framework, designs and realizes the related function. The principle design methods of the guide system is described from the perspective of information transmission. Then, from the different needs of tourists, tourism management departments and tourism related enterprises, and from the key to the branch, the functions of the intelligent scenic spot information management service system are designed in detail according to the top-down. The system level computing, massive data processing, resource arrangement, natural semantic analysis and other methods are also used to realize the statistics, analysis and prediction of tourism big data, combining with various programming languages, algorithms and technologies. Finally, the research results are applied in specific cases to provide tourists with a set of fast, convenient and practical tourism programs.

articleTitle: Automated Operational Modal Analysis Based on DBSCAN Clustering
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Stochastic subspace identification uses the frequency stability graph as the judgment standard of recognition results, and the introduction of clustering algorithm makes the automatic recognition of stability graph possible. At present, the clustering algorithm generally has subjective input parameter selection, complex algorithm theory and human intervention. The characteristic of stability chart is that the physical mode density is large, while the false mode density is small. DBSCAN clustering is a density based clustering algorithm, which can identify any shape of the class. According to the characteristics of the stability diagram, this paper proposes an automated operational modal analysis algorithm based on DBSCAN clustering, which is applied to the benchmark model of Z24 bridge in Switzerland. The results show that the method is feasible in the automated operational modal analysis of bridge structures.

articleTitle: Research on Effects of Near-Fault Earthquake Ground Motion Characteristics on Seismic Response of the Steel-Concrete Plate Composite Beam Bridge with Transverse Supported Steel Beams
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Forward-directivity, hanging wall effect and non-pulse ground motions in the near-fault region are selected respectively for research on effects of characteristics of near-fault ground motions on seismic response of the steel-concrete plate composite beam bridge with transverse supported steel beams. It is shown that the effects of forward-directivity on seismic response are the most significant and the influence of hanging wall effect on seismic response is similar to that of non-pulse near-fault ground motions. The more seismic demand important bridge columns have, the more effects on seismic response of important bridge columns characteristics of near-fault ground motions have.

Author Keywords: Steel-Concrete Plate Composite Beam Bridge With Transverse Supported Steel Beam

articleTitle: Research on an Improved CNN Speech Recognition System Based on Hidden Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of speech recognition and speaker identification in the field of production and life, an improved convolutional neural network algorithm based on hidden markov model is proposed, which includes four parts: feature extraction, segmentation, training and clustering. Quantization and clustering were carried out in the recorded sound set, the feature vectors of the obtained sound signal were segmented, and further training was conducted by deep convolutional network. Finally, after the state segmentation of HMM was completed, the recognition was completed by CNN as the input part of CNN. The experimental results show that the improved CNN based on hidden markov model can complete the recognition function and verify the correctness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Deepening Application and Practice of BIM Based on Smart City in Cost Control and Cost Collaborative Management
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: Based on in-depth analysis of BIM's technical characteristics, this paper studies the specific application and practice of BIM Technology based on Smart City in the whole process of project construction in cost control and cost Collaborative management, in order to provide a scientific reference for the practical application of BIM technology. By establishing the parameter model, the data of each parameter model can be centralized and integrated, realizing the Sharing and Transfer of Information in Each Link and Subject, while providing the possibility of collaboration among the construction subjects, it also helps to improve construction efficiency, reduce cost effectively and shorten construction period. In conclusion, BIM Technology is not only an effective measure to strengthen cost control and cost collaborative management, but also an exhibition of Smart City.

articleTitle: Beamforming Technology Based on Multi-cell 3D MIMO System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to increase the anti-interference ability of the current 3DMIMO system and increase its system capacity, this paper proposes a new 3DMIMO beamforming algorithm based on the multi-cell multi-user model. The 3D channel is divided into two independent 2D channels, which are respectively shaped. In the horizontal dimension, the idea of zero-forcing is used, and in the vertical dimension, a mathematical model based on game theory is used to maximize the amount of information of the target users themselves, and at the same time, make the information leaked to users in the same or neighboring cells as possible The smallest. The beamforming vector obtained by the final 3D game algorithm is a linear combination of beamforming vectors of horizontal and vertical dimensions. According to the simulation results, it can be seen that the system capacity reaches the maximum value when iterating 2-3 times. It can be seen that the complexity of the algorithm is low, and compared with the K-means algorithm, the algorithm makes the user's total throughput higher. Experimental results show that this method achieves the maximum total system capacity of all users in multiple cells on the basis of balancing the interference between users and the received power of the users.

articleTitle: The Impact of Monetary Policy on China's Stock Prices Base on TVP-VAR Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: With the background of the government's DE-leveraging policy, the central bank has created macro-controls for the capital markets by formulating different monetary policies during different economic cycles in recent years. Unfortunately, in existing research results, scholars have usually only measured the effects of monetary policy based on the response of the stock market to the monetary policy during that same period. Therefore this article makes a time-varied analysis of the specific impact of monetary policy by using the TVP-VAR model. At the end of the paper get the following conclusions: The impact of money supply on cyclical share price, when the economic cycle going up, the impact is negative, when the economic cycle going down, the impact is positive; The impact of money supply on non-cyclical share price is positive; The effect of interest rates on cyclical share prices depends on the proportion of stock price bubbles is negative; The effect of interest rates on non-cyclical share prices depends on the market expectations is positive.

Author Keywords: TVP-VAR model, money supply, interest rate, cyclical industry, non-cyclical industry

articleTitle: Research on the Communication Mode of Big Data Technology in the Field of Dongba Character Graphic Design
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: In order to improve the communication efficiency of big data technology in the field of Dongba character graphic design, this paper puts forward a novel opportunity big data technology communication mode in the field of Dongba character graphic design. This model is based on big data technology and can collect and mine data in the field of Dongba character graphic design. The research results show that this model can effectively improve the communication efficiency of big data technology in the field of Dongba character graphic design, and realize the wide application of Dongba character in the field of graphic design.

articleTitle: Experiment Test and Numerical Simulation of Cable-Sliding Friction Aseismic Bearing with Buffer
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: By adding cable devices to common Pot bearings or Steel ball bearings creatively, cable sliding friction aseismic bearings (CSFAB) could not only have the advantages of sliding friction isolation bearings, but also overcome the defect of the sliding friction isolation bearings, which could avoid the unseating of girder during earthquake. Further development of CSFAB is proposed in this paper, by adding "cable-spring" system to conventional CSFAB. This new type of CSFAB is referred to as CSFAB with buffer. The feasibility of the CSFAB with buffer is verified by prototype of the bearing and corresponding pseudo-static test. The actual performance of the bearing is in good agreement with the theoretical model.

articleTitle: DDA Analysis of Long-Term Stability of Left Abutment Slope of Jinping I Hydropower Station
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Intelligent Transportation, Big Data & Smart City (ICITBS)
abstract: The left abutment slope of Jinping I hydropower station has an large excavation height. Meanwhile, the faults and joints in the slope rock mass are developed. The long-term stability of the slope has an important influence on the normal operation of the hydropower station. In this paper, the creep constitutive model describing the "stress-strain-time" relationship of rock mass is combined with the discontinuous deformation analysis (DDA) method, and the DDA based creep simulation method for jointed rock mass is proposed. Based on the monitoring data of the project, the extended DDA program is used to carry out the back analysis of the creep parameters i of slope operation. Based on the inversion results and considering the changes of boundary conditions, the long-term deformation of slope is simulated and predicted.
